[We just filed two FOIA requests to get information about the conditions in immigration detention centers and how pregnant, postpartum, and nursing women and adolescents are being treated... or are not.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/126548258/605245388/2141984067?sourceid=1151191&utm_campaign=ice detainees&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=investigateicedetention&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjNGRhYWJmOC0xNzE3LWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2ExZjBhOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BBCuo17CIxNN0-iSQ8zyMJaI9FIP4jo3U0miLX5rlhI=&emci=2bd37da5-7516-f111-a69a-000d3a1f0a97&emdi=c4daabf8-1717-f111-a69a-000d3a1f0a97&ceid=954237) | [FIGHT BACK](https://click.everyaction.com/k/126548260/605245390/2141984067?sourceid=1151191&utm_campaign=ice detainees&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=investigateicedetention&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjNGRhYWJmOC0xNzE3LWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2ExZjBhOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BBCuo17CIxNN0-iSQ8zyMJaI9FIP4jo3U0miLX5rlhI=&emci=2bd37da5-7516-f111-a69a-000d3a1f0a97&emdi=c4daabf8-1717-f111-a69a-000d3a1f0a97&ceid=954237)
---
Members of Congress have already identified hundreds of credible reports of abuse in immigration detention. Are pregnant, postpartum, and nursing women waiting weeks for sub-par care? Are they being forced to sleep on the floor due to overcrowding? Are they being denied adequate food and water? And is it true that some women in detention have suffered miscarriages?

Equally alarming, reporting alleges that pregnant and parenting adolescent immigrants are being shepherded into Texas—a state with extremely restrictive abortion laws and policies—without clear access to appropriate pregnancy-related care, including abortion care.

[The public needs answers, and we’re getting them.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/126548262/605245392/2141984067?sourceid=1151191&utm_campaign=ice detainees&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=investigateicedetention&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjNGRhYWJmOC0xNzE3LWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2ExZjBhOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BBCuo17CIxNN0-iSQ8zyMJaI9FIP4jo3U0miLX5rlhI=&emci=2bd37da5-7516-f111-a69a-000d3a1f0a97&emdi=c4daabf8-1717-f111-a69a-000d3a1f0a97&ceid=954237) Here's how:
* **FOIA filed with DHS:** We've filed a Freedom of Information (FOIA) with the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) regarding the detainment and treatment of pregnant, postpartum, and nursing immigrants, their care (or lack thereof).
* **FOIA filed with HHS:** We've filed a FOIA with the Department of Health and Human Services' (HHS) Office of Refugee Resettlement regarding detention of pregnant and parenting adolescent immigrants, their ability to access care, and communications regarding their transfer to a specific facility in Texas.

[FUEL THE FIGHT](https://click.everyaction.com/k/126548264/605245394/2141984067?sourceid=1151191&utm_campaign=ice detainees&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=investigateicedetention&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjNGRhYWJmOC0xNzE3LWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2ExZjBhOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BBCuo17CIxNN0-iSQ8zyMJaI9FIP4jo3U0miLX5rlhI=&emci=2bd37da5-7516-f111-a69a-000d3a1f0a97&emdi=c4daabf8-1717-f111-a69a-000d3a1f0a97&ceid=954237)

Are pregnant, postpartum, and nursing women waiting weeks for sub-par care? Are they being forced to sleep on the floor due to overcrowding? Are they being denied adequate food and water? And is it true that some women in detention have suffered miscarriages? I’m Dr. Annie Andrews, a pediatrician, a mom of three, and the Democrat running for U.S. Senate to defeat Republican Lindsey Graham in South Carolina.
If we flip this seat, we can end Lindsey Graham’s career and help Democrats retake the Senate, and expand the map for Democrats in future elections.
I know this won’t be easy. But I’ve treated kids who were shot, hospitalized, and failed by broken systems. Nothing about this moment feels optional.
We need an overwhelming surge of grassroots support to prove that we can finally defeat Lindsey Graham. So I’m humbly asking: Will you chip in a split donation of $50, $30, or even $15 between Resist Reclaim Rebuild and my campaign right now so we can hit our end of quarter goals? >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-annieandrews] [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-annieandrews]
HELP ME DEFEAT LINDSEY GRAHAM! >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-annieandrews]
Let me introduce myself.
I’ve spent nearly 20 years serving my community as a pediatrician, treating everything from asthma and violent trauma to the emotional toll of growing up in poverty.
I’ve seen what bad policy does to good families — and I’ve seen kids suffer because people like Lindsey Graham would rather protect their own power than protect children.
In 2022, after 15 years of working in hospitals, I ran for Congress because I knew our kids needed a voice in Washington. I lost — and I told my oldest daughter I wouldn’t run again.
But then Trump’s chaos came back.
And Lindsey Graham? He cheered.

| | | Vicente Gonzalez, a life-long Democrat, is a candidate for Texas’ 34th U.S. Congressional District.

[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126551940/605254647/-522966747?refcode=gonzalez-prospects-2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MTAzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5YWFjMmRiNC0xYTE3LWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2ExZjBhOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BJ3npzOnjqWc2iFh3kO95HoRB90aOzOB4027g4jrvBg=)

From humble beginnings, Vicente was raised in a military family. Through hard work and pure ganas, Vicente aimed to make something of himself. His mother stressed to him over and over again that education was the key that will open doors of opportunities. Vicente made the decision to get his life back on track by going back to school to get his GED, working and attending classes at community college, and earning his college degree alongside other military families at the Embry Riddle Aeronautical University on the Corpus Christi Naval Air Station. Vicente surpassed his and his parents' dreams when he graduated from Texas A&M School of Law, earning his Juris Doctorate degree.

While in law school, Vicente learned how government should work. Through his experience as a Congressional Intern in Washington, D.C., Vicente learned how government really works. After law school, Vicente didn’t stop learning, and continued his training in Negotiation at Harvard University School of Law.

Vicente started his business, the Law Offices of V. Gonzalez and Associates, in McAllen and married Lorena Saenz, a former teacher and administrator in Edinburg and McAllen schools. Vicente has focused his practice on fighting for a level playing field for working families wronged by corporations and insurance companies evading responsibility. Through several victories for our community, Vicente recovered millions in tax dollars for South Texas school districts after shady contractors misspent millions in bond money and put our children in physical danger.

Today, Vicente Gonzalez is fighting for our South Texas values in Congress as a member of the Committees on Financial Services and Capital Markets and the National Security, Illicit Finance, and International Financial Institutions subcommittees. Vicente has stood by our promise to veterans, helping constituents cut through red tape at the VA and working across the aisle to prevent the shameful deportation of our honorably discharged veterans. He’s working to lower prescription drug prices, protect the benefits and healthcare of seniors, and ensure that jobs and opportunities are there for all with the ganas to work.

United States

Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Folks,
Due to a USPS change, most of the country’s mail dropped in a blue box or handed to a mail carrier on or before an election deadline is no longer guaranteed to receive a real-time postmark. In some cases, postmarks may not be applied for days. That delay can be the difference between a vote that counts and a vote that gets thrown out.
Postmarks are how election officials decide whether a ballot was mailed on time. When postmarks are delayed, ballots become vulnerable to rejection, legal challenges, and partisan games after Election Day. When mail processing is delayed, postmarks lag, and deadlines become murky for voters who tried to do everything right.
This creates a huge risk of opponents of voting rights pushing to discount ballots after the fact.
We must protect vote by mail! Add your name to send a direct message urging your members of Congress to demand the USPS restore real-time postmarks now >> [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/protect-vote-by-mail/?source=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions]
START WRITING NOW ⇨ [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/protect-vote-by-mail/?source=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions]
This change is the direct result of former Postmaster General Louis DeJoy’s Regional Transportation Optimization (RTO) plan that quietly went into effect last year.
DeJoy spent years consolidating mail processing out of local communities and centralized it into massive regional hubs that can be hundreds of miles away, sometimes in another state. That means ballots dropped at neighborhood post offices or blue boxes in most of the country are no longer processed locally.
Rural voters and anyone who lives more than 50 miles from one of these mega processing centers are hit hardest – so, most of the country. Many of us rely on mail service for casting our votes, getting prescriptions, paying rent and mortgages, the list goes on. Seniors, veterans, and voters without easy access to in-person voting are especially at risk. Republicans and Democrats alike depend on timely postmarks to ensure their votes count.
The good news is that when it comes to the Postal Service, public pressure works! It worked when we forced DeJoy to pause processing plant consolidation chaos. It worked when Congress intervened to protect election mail in past cycles. It worked when we blocked Trump’s attempt to move the USPS under the control of the Commerce Department and when the administration floated the idea of firing the entire Board of Governors.
Demand the USPS restore real-time postmarks and protect vote by mail today! >> [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/protect-vote-by-mail/?source=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions]

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.

### A Substitute Teacher Speaks Out
---

| | Geno Young — author of Sex, Drugs and Illiteracy: The Death of Education in America — shares what he witnessed during his year as a substitute teacher in a south suburb of Chicago, and why he believes America’s education system is in serious decline. From classroom disorder to falling literacy rates, we unpack the uncomfortable realities many parents and educators hesitate to address. Why are American students falling behind their peers around the world? What’s really happening inside public schools? If you care about the future of education — as a parent, teacher, policymaker, or engaged citizen — this is a conversation you won’t want to miss. | | Do we really need new ideas to fix America’s schools? In a culture that often drifts away from clear logic and common sense, even the most straightforward solutions can start to sound radical. The time-tested structures grounded in sound judgment and solid data — the ones that consistently deliver results for students — somehow feel unfashionable in today’s debate. Our schools weren’t perfect either, but they were markedly different than now. The drivers then were math, English, science, history, social studies, literature, PE, etc. Can public education be saved? Should it be saved? We would like to think there is hope for the future. clean_body: A Substitute Teacher Speaks Out | Geno Young — author of Sex, Drugs and Illiteracy: The Death of Education in America — shares what he witnessed during his year as a substitute teacher in a south suburb of Chicago, and why he believes America’s education system is in serious declin | | Can 't see this message? | | | | | | | March 3, 2026 Newsletter | | A Substitute Teacher Speaks Out | | | | Geno Young — author of Sex, Drugs and Illiteracy: The Death of Education in America — shares what he witnessed during his year as a substitute teacher in a south suburb of Chicago, and why he believes America’s education system is in serious decline. From classroom disorder to falling literacy rates, we unpack the uncomfortable realities many parents and educators hesitate to address. Why are American students falling behind their peers around the world? What’s really happening inside public schools? If you care about the future of education — as a parent, teacher, policymaker, or engaged citizen — this is a conversation you won’t want to miss. Listen to the full podcast on: , , or . | | | | | | “Back-to-Basics” Solutions That Might Transform Public Education | | | | Do we really need new ideas to fix America’s schools? In a culture that often drifts away from clear logic and common sense, even the most straightforward solutions can start to sound radical. The time-tested structures grounded in sound judgment and solid data — the ones that consistently deliver results for students — somehow feel unfashionable in today’s debate. Our schools weren’t perfect either, but they were markedly different than now. The drivers then were math, English, science, history, social studies, literature, PE, etc. Can public education be saved? Should it be saved? We would like to think there is hope for the future. # These bills die w/out you
| | | [Brian Lenney](https://substack.com/@brianlenney)
---
| Mar 3
---
| [](https://substack.com/@brianlenney)
---
We have a whole pile of bills dealing with illegal immigration sitting right now in the Idaho Senate...
Some are crawling through the house. And a handful actually made it through and landed on Kelly Anthon's desk.
This is THE DEFINING ISSUE of our day. In America, and in Idaho. It's not a "fed" problem - it's ours. Because illegal immigration hits our bank accounts, floods our cities, tanks our safety, kills jobs, overwhelms schools, and guts the economy and way of life we're trying to protect for our kids.
Enough.
These bills need a vote. They need a fair shake. And right now Kelly Anthon controls whether that happens.
So call him. **(208) 332-1300**. Email him. **[KAnthon@senate.idaho.gov](https://substack.com/redirect/b464adb4-aa64-49e0-b427-1b2203f243ef?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**. Do both. Today.
Don't sit back assuming someone else will. They won't. This only moves if regular people make noise.
One call. One email. That's it.
Do it now.
Thanks,
Brian

body:
I want to be clear about what I’m fighting for
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Today is Election Day, Peter.
This is what everything has been building towards. Our right to vote is sacred. It determines who represents us, what laws get passed, and what kind of Texas our kids and grandkids inherit. So as Texans get ready to vote today,**I want to be clear about what I’m fighting for.**
I’m fighting for an affordable Texas by taking on corporate greed that is making life more expensive for working families.
I’m fighting for quality and accessible health care for all Texans and putting patients over profits once and for all.
And I’m fighting to protect public schools and stop Greg Abbott’s voucher scheme.
I’m running for governor because I stand with Texans trying to afford a roof over their heads, not tax cuts for the wealthy. I stand with the most vulnerable, not the richest among us. **Simply put, I stand for all Texans, Peter, and I _always_ will.**
Right now, my team is on the ground and on the phones turning out voters across Texas to get us over this first hurdle and into the strongest possible position for November. Every conversation today can be the difference between falling short and building the momentum we need to defeat Greg Abbott.

| | Peter,
From the very beginning of this race, I committed to work hard, travel the district, and earn every vote. We’ve visited every county in TX-21 and I’ve truly enjoyed meeting so many Texans who love this country as much as I do.
I’m grateful to be **endorsed by President Trump and** **Governor Abbott** , along with leading conservative organizations like Turning Point, Club for Growth, National Border Patrol Council, Susan B. Anthony List, and National Association for Gun Rights – plus more than 100 conservative leaders across TX-21.
I’m a Christian, husband and father ready to serve. I’ll fight to secure the border, lower inflation, defend our God-given rights, and take on the D.C. Swamp.
Now it comes down to turnout – **VOTE TEX today** , and remind your friends to vote. [**Find polling places HERE**](https://teixeiraforcongress.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=aaeca7d0d6f0c241ad9d38cc7&id=b76011c9bb&e=2814cf23ed). Polls close at 7:00 PM.
I’m so grateful for all the support and prayers we’ve received throughout this campaign. Let’s finish strong and win this tonight! 🇺🇸
Thank you and God bless,
**Mark “Tex” Teixeira** Trump-Endorsed America First ConservativeTexas’ 21st Congressional District

A look back at Obama's "coalition of the ascendant" proves out why Democratic electoral dominance never materialized as many predicted. The coalition that seemed destined to create a lasting progressive majority has instead revealed itself as inherently unstable, a phenomenon further illuminated by the disintegration of various progressive movements in subsequent years.

The core weakness of this coalition lies in its contradictory composition--uniting affluent gentry liberals with economically disadvantaged minorities, while largely ignoring the working-class voters who once formed the Democratic backbone. This top-bottom coalition lacks coherence beyond opposition to perceived conservative threats, explaining why it appears "intermittent and unstable" and reliably emerges only during presidential election years.

Recent developments further validate the coalition's structural fragility. The BLM movement, which initially appeared to represent a powerful new force for racial justice, has been undermined by revelations of financial mismanagement and questionable use of donations. Rather than evolving into a sustainable grassroots movement, it has demonstrated how activist organizations can be co-opted by financial interests that ultimately serve established power structures.

Similarly, the contradiction between avowed progressive ideals and violent tactics has damaged movements like Antifa. The public's growing awareness of how these groups employ intimidation and property destruction has diminished their moral authority beyond their most committed adherents. This disconnect illustrates the broader failure of movements that rely on fear rather than persuasion to advance their agenda.

The massive welfare fraud scandal in Minnesota represents perhaps the most damaging blow to Democratic credibility. The "Feeding Our Future" fraud scheme, which has already implicated nearly 80 people with billions stolen from programs intended to feed hungry children and support vulnerable families, has revealed how easily social safety nets can be exploited. What makes this particularly devastating for Democratic coalitions is that the fraud occurred under Governor Tim Walz's watch, with evidence suggesting state officials ignored warnings for years. This disillusionment cuts both ways--honest welfare recipients who genuinely need assistance are now stigmatized by suspicion, while faithful Democratic voters who supported these programs feel betrayed by their leaders' failure to safeguard taxpayer dollars. The Minnesota scandal validates conservative critiques about the need for stricter oversight, while undermining progressive arguments for expanded social programs.

Most revealing have been the Epstein and Weinstein scandals, which have exposed how financial elites successfully cultivate relationships with ostensibly progressive organizations and causes. These revelations demonstrate not the ascendancy of genuine grassroots movements, but rather how easily influential figures can manipulate activist causes through strategic funding and access. The pattern of wealthy donors shaping progressive agendas while maintaining their own privileged positions reveals the hollow core of what appeared to be popular movements.

"I am going to need a place to channel that anger, so I've decided that I'm going to give the NRA my full attention" Harvey Weinstein said turning the focus on NRA and Trump after sexual misconduct bombshell.
The World Economic Forum's agenda represents the ultimate manifestation of this phenomenon--co-opting legitimate concerns about inequality and environmental issues to promote an economic model that ultimately benefits global elites. This explains why there is growing disillusionment across the political spectrum with establishments claiming to speak for ordinary people while advancing policies that concentrate power and wealth.

What appeared to be the rise of new progressive forces has instead revealed itself as a series of controlled oppositions--movements that appear revolutionary but ultimately reinforce existing power structures. This explains why Democratic electoral fortunes have increasingly depended on demonizing opponents rather than offering compelling positive visions that unite diverse constituencies.

The truth emerging is that authentic political change requires coalitions grounded in shared material interests rather than manufactured cultural grievances. As Americans become more aware of how financial and cultural elites manipulate social movements, we may witness a realignment that transcends the false dichotomies that have defined recent political discourse. The coalition's failure stems not from demographic changes, but from the inherent resistance of diverse groups to supporting agendas that ultimately undermine their autonomy and prosperity.

If you're a football fan, there's a good chance you already know me.
Maybe kicking a field goal on Monday night football – I did that for 14 years.
But I also spent years in the broadcast booth with CBS Sports calling NFL and college football games. There's a good chance you've spent a few afternoons together with me breaking down plays, analyzing coaching decisions and talking ball.
_**You know how it works in football...**_ When leadership fails, _the_ _locker room knows._
When the play calling is bad, _the fans know._
When the game's on the line, _big players step up._
I think a lot of the same principles apply to our nation. And right now, the game is on the line, and that's why I'm stepping and running for Congress as an America First Republican.

subject: Re: Breaking: Funding for Oregon’s wildlife now heads to the Senate for a vote!
body:
Hi Peter,
I’m following up again with an update: 1.25% for Wildlife ( HB 4134 [https://olis.oregonlegislature.gov/liz/2026R1/Measures/Overview/HB4134] ) has been scheduled for a second reading in the Senate, which means that it will be up for a vote very soon! Please reach out one more time to let your senator know how important landmark wildlife and habitat conservation funding is to you. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/zjI6vv5pZUWATqdnW3ePAw2]
Send your message [https://secure.ngpvan.com/zjI6vv5pZUWATqdnW3ePAw2?contactdata=axISB/jfFsMSV549Qd2lIQChJE33WoFEe7zu50iv+fxe098/IFMHxZkWhB16ztg1dNNREFMvJsOHG/2c9aqyHv0TACM57Esv2FWA0fklUKtG47KykkatQLvLfybMx6ZO]
Take a second to use your voice for our wildlife before it is too late. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/zjI6vv5pZUWATqdnW3ePAw2]
Calling your senator directly can be very impactful, so if you are able, please call them directly to tell them you support this bill! Here is a link to find your Senator’s office number [http://geo.maps.arcgis.com/apps/instant/lookup/index.html?appid=fd070b56c975456ea2a25f7e3f4289d1%3F&find=6115+se+87th+ave] .
Thank you for your support,
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/AV/AVLCV/1/70877/images/Eliza.png]
Eliza Walton (she/they)
OLCV Coalition Director

Hi Peter,
Today, 1.25% for Wildlife ( HB 4134 [https://olis.oregonlegislature.gov/liz/2026R1/Measures/Overview/HB4134] ) – a bill for landmark wildlife funding – passed the House! It is now headed to the Senate for a vote. If you haven’t taken action yet to support this priority bill during this year’s legislative session, now is your chance to be a part of the movement for this historic wildlife and habitat funding! [https://secure.ngpvan.com/zjI6vv5pZUWATqdnW3ePAw2]
Send your message [https://secure.ngpvan.com/zjI6vv5pZUWATqdnW3ePAw2?contactdata=axISB/jfFsMSV549Qd2lIQChJE33WoFEe7zu50iv+fxe098/IFMHxZkWhB16ztg1dNNREFMvJsOHG/2c9aqyHv0TACM57Esv2FWA0fklUKtG47KykkatQLvLfybMx6ZO]
If you don’t already know, 1.25% for Wildlife would secure landmark wildlife and habitat conservation funding by dedicating a small share of Oregon’s transient lodging tax to our wildlife. Oregon’s transient lodging tax is currently one of the lowest in the country, and this increase will still keep it at one of the lowest levels, while providing our endangered wildlife with the support they desperately need.
Oregon’s wildlife is at a tipping point. 1.25% for Wildlife is our chance to make a real difference for Oregon’s endangered species.
Take action now and urge your senator to vote YES on HB 4134! [https://secure.ngpvan.com/zjI6vv5pZUWATqdnW3ePAw2]
Thank you for your support,
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/AV/AVLCV/1/70877/images/Eliza.png]
Eliza Walton (she/they)
OLCV Coalition Director

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. Today, we celebrate the spirit and vibrant community of the city so many of us are lucky to call home

[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126560368/605282407/-1473932214?refcode=logo&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83MjY1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZGE2NzdhNy0yNjE3LWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2ExZjBhOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=0qCBVbrVnQ20wCCbpZ0qFNJvMjsAx6sV9v4upsbajCo=) **Happy 303 Day, Denver!** Today, we celebrate the spirit and vibrant community of the city so many of us are lucky to call home — and the city I had the great honor of serving as mayor! [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126560369/605282408/1664162816?refcode=email_030326_303day&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83MjY1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZGE2NzdhNy0yNjE3LWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2ExZjBhOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=0qCBVbrVnQ20wCCbpZ0qFNJvMjsAx6sV9v4upsbajCo=) I didn’t get into politics to serve myself or the highest bidder. I was running the state’s first brewpub, the Wynkoop, and saw that when you bring people together and improve each other’s ideas, you can _actually _get stuff done. That’s when I decided to run for mayor. The Wynkoop wasn’t just about serving beer. It was a place where people sat across from folks they didn’t always know or agree with, and still managed to build relationships, to work out their differences. That spirit shaped how our team sees public service. You listen. You stay curious. You try to solve problems instead of making them worse. As mayor, we brought folks together and revitalized Denver's public transit system, and we’ve continued that work in the U.S. Senate. Together, we’ve invested billions to confront the climate crisis, lowered drug costs for seniors, and made investments to rebuild our infrastructure. There’s still plenty of work to do to solve real problems and move our state forward, _and we’re not done yet._ From serving as Mayor of Denver, to Governor of Colorado, to our U.S. Senator — I’m ready to keep up this fight for Colorado and continue representing our values in DC. **_[If you’re with us, we’re humbly asking you to donate a few bucks today to help us keep fighting for the city and state we love so much. Today, we celebrate the spirit and vibrant community of the city so many of us are lucky to call home — and the city I had the great honor of serving as mayor! = I didn’t get into politics to serve myself or the highest bidder. I was running the state’s first brewpub, the Wynkoop, and saw that when you bring people together and improve each other’s ideas, you can actually get stuff done. That’s when I decided to run for mayor. The Wynkoop wasn’t just about serving beer. It was a place where people sat across from folks they didn’t always know or agree with, and still managed to build relationships, to work out their differences. That spirit shaped how our team sees public service. You listen. You stay curious. You try to solve problems instead of making them worse. As mayor, we brought folks together and revitalized Denver's public transit system, and we’ve continued that work in the U.S. Senate. Together, we’ve invested billions to confront the climate crisis, lowered drug costs for seniors, and made investments to rebuild our infrastructure. body:
[ stdin# ]Our Revolution Logo

Peter Willis,

Trump's illegal war with Iran is spiraling out of control – and Congress
has only hours left to slam on the brakes.

As Trump refuses to rule out sending American troops into another
disastrous Middle East conflict, Bernie is sounding the alarm, demanding
Congress pass a war powers resolution to rein Trump in *immediately*.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/35881?source=email-20230303&t=1011&akid=10316%2E5885482%2EhlltRW ]Bernie Sanders tweet on Iran: This Trump-Netanyahu war is
unconstitutional and violates international law. It endangers the lives of
US troops and people across the region. We've lived through Vietnam and
Iraq. No more endless wars. Congress must pass a War Powers Resolution
immediately.

Votes are happening TOMORROW and THURSDAY and we need a tidal wave of
grassroots pressure demanding Congress do its job and stop this illegal
war.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/35881?source=email-20230303&t=1012&akid=10316%2E5885482%2EhlltRW ]Add your name now to tell Congress: Pass a war powers resolution
IMMEDIATELY and stop Trump's reckless war machine. We need thousands of
voices right now before Congress votes in HOURS!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/35881?source=email-20230303&t=1013&akid=10316%2E5885482%2EhlltRW ]ADD YOUR NAME

This is nowhere near over. Yesterday, Trump warned of a "big wave" of
attacks yet to come. The Trump-Netanyahu alliance has unleashed complete
chaos as explosions rip through cities across the region – Dubai, Abu
Dhabi, Doha – and as Israel and Hezbollah trade fire. And it's all
happening without the necessary authorization from Congress.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/35881?source=email-20230303&t=1014&akid=10316%2E5885482%2EhlltRW ]Headline: Trump's Iran Attack Was Illegal, Former US Military Officials
Allege

It could not be clearer that Trump has dragged us into a war with no
endgame, no congressional debate, and no concern for who gets killed. But
with the House and Senate vote TOMORROW and THURSDAY, we have a crucial
chance to stop another forever war. Our Revolution members joined an
emergency anti-war rally at the White House, and now we're working with a
broad anti-war coalition to force Congress to act before it's too late.
But we need you with us.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/35881?source=email-20230303&t=1015&akid=10316%2E5885482%2EhlltRW ]Stand with Bernie and send an urgent message to Congress now, demanding
it pass a war powers resolution to put an end to Trump's illegal war
before it's too late. Every signature counts and every second matters. It
is up to us to overwhelm Congress and remind them that the American people
will not be silenced or sidelined as our country is pulled into yet
another catastrophe.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/35881?source=email-20230303&t=1016&akid=10316%2E5885482%2EhlltRW ]ADD YOUR NAME

When we organize, we win,

Our Revolution

name: Team Jack
subject: Nancy Pelosi: “Jack represents the best of his generation”
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-jack?refcode=030326_2 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-jack?refcode=030326_2]
Speaker Emerita Nancy Pelosi just endorsed Jack for Congress, and what she said about him matters (but before we go on - will you split a donation between Jack and Outrage then Action PAC right now? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-jack?refcode=030326_2]
This isn't just a political endorsement. This is one of the most effective leaders in modern history telling us exactly why Jack is the candidate we need right now.
Speaker Emerita Pelosi knows what we're up against — Trump's chaos, RFK Jr. gutting healthcare, an administration running unchecked. And she's endorsing Jack because she believes he can fight back and win.
Here's what she said:
"Jack Schlossberg is giving people something to believe in again and something to vote for. His candidacy will help democrats win nationwide — and it will help us flip the House."
But Peter, she didn't stop there. She got specific about what makes Jack different:
"Jack understands that progress is not some abstract idea— it must be felt in daily life, in neighborhoods, and in hopes for the future. He has released specific policies to address local challenges facing his district—plans to lower costs at the grocery store and for families, his housing initiative, his public safety measures for houses of worship, and a way to tackle the flow of illegal guns at the federal level, and more. Jack has the mettle and the moxie to get his policies passed in Congress, and the ability to bring all sides to the table."
That's what we need right now. Not empty promises — real policies that will make a difference in people's lives. And someone with the strength to actually get them passed.
And here's the part that really matters in this moment:
"Jack possesses a unique ability to navigate the digital and the classical political worlds in ways that can get things done for people — and hold President Trump accoun table. Those skills are critical right now, and they are also quite rare."
That's why she's backing Jack. Because he can hold Trump accountable. Because he has concrete plans to help people. Because he represents a new generation ready to do the hard work.
But endorsements don't win races — people do.
So, will you join Speaker Emerita Pelosi by splitting a donation between Jack and Outrage then Action today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-jack?refcode=030326_2]

## Trump's decisive action in Iran...
This weekend, the United States [carried out precise strikes](https://substack.com/redirect/25ec930e-2921-4ce2-9b5f-66c2953c8be3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on strategic sites and figures in the oppressive Iranian regime.
This was a huge win for America, the Iranian people, and the world.
For decades Iran has been a consistent threat.
They've funded terrorism, destabilized the region, and raced towards a nuclear weapon.
Meanwhile, President Trump has been consistent on this for years: Iran should never be permitted to obtain a nuclear weapon.
In fact, here's a list of [74 times](https://substack.com/redirect/92d415dd-b147-4ec5-9901-a22cb5de38a1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that Trump said Iran would never have a nuclear weapon.
He made that clear years before he ran for office, he confirmed it in his first term, and he's remaining true to his word now.
This week he backed words with action, and the world is safer for it.
Let's break it down...

| | | | | |
Friends,
Brad continues to stand apart in the race for Governor. **He is the only candidate with detailed plans to make Georgia more affordable and safe.**
Last week, Brad announced his plan to [eliminate the state income tax on all retirement benefits](https://BradForGeorgia.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb0b5d8f4cac8238170f7992f&id=cca60cd273&e=6036811227). This common sense policy will ensure seniors can keep more of the money they earned and strengthen their financial security amid rising costs.

As a Christian, conservative businessman, Brad believes that hardworking Georgians should be able to keep more of what they earn. Retirees should be rewarded - not penalized - for their efforts (and fiscal discipline).
The retirement relief plan builds on Brad’s plan to cap property tax growth, eliminate non-education and non-public safety property taxes for seniors, make Georgia the number one state for reshoring and job creation, double school safety grants to $100,000 per school including private schools, and fully fund and staff law enforcement agencies.
Click [HERE](https://BradForGeorgia.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb0b5d8f4cac8238170f7992f&id=fbe40e3e3a&e=6036811227) to review Brad’s policy proposals.
While other candidates are busy playing politics, Brad is fighting to make Georgia more affordable and safe. He will Stand for Georgia - No Matter What.
– Team Raff
---
[|
---](https://BradForGeorgia.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb0b5d8f4cac8238170f7992f&id=f34563159b&e=6036811227)
| |
[**Brad’s Blueprint for Georgia**](https://BradForGeorgia.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb0b5d8f4cac8238170f7992f&id=b225180fdd&e=6036811227)
---
| |
Brad Raffensperger is the most conservative candidate for Governor and his policy proposals are resonating with Georgians. Every week, more and more voters are hearing Brad’s [Blueprint for Georgia](https://BradForGeorgia.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb0b5d8f4cac8238170f7992f&id=e1bdb72274&e=6036811227) and how it will make Georgia affordable and safe.
---
| |
**Retirement Income Tax Relief:** Eliminating state income taxes on retirement benefits to help Georgia seniors keep more of what they earned and improve long-term financial security.
* Eliminate state income tax on all retirement distributions, including 401(k)s, traditional IRAs, pensions, annuities, and Required Minimum Distributions.
* Build on existing retirement income exclusions to make Georgia fully retirement-income tax free while continuing the Social Security exemption.
* This plan delivers meaningful long-term savings, with retirees potentially retaining more than $100,000 during their retirement years.

**Property Tax Relief:** Protecting homeownership and improving affordability requires predictable property taxes and targeted relief for seniors.
* Cap property tax growth at the rate of inflation for all homeowners.
* Require voter approval to exceed the property tax cap.
* Eliminate non-education and non-public safety property taxes for seniors.
* This plan establishes a uniform statewide property tax system across all counties.

---
| |
[**Certified Pro-Life**](https://BradForGeorgia.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb0b5d8f4cac8238170f7992f&id=f40069311c&e=6036811227)
---
| |

As a Christian, father, and grandfather, Brad believes every human life has inherent value and deserves protection. He is proud to be certified pro-life by the Georgia Life Alliance Committee and remains committed to advocating for policies that protect the most vulnerable among us.
---
|
---
| |
**Poll Shows Momentum is Building**
---
| | A [new poll](https://BradForGeorgia.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb0b5d8f4cac8238170f7992f&id=ee905793f0&e=6036811227) shows what we’ve been seeing firsthand across Georgia for weeks, Brad’s message is resonating with voters and building real momentum.
While other candidates in this race are busy trying to score political points and fight for clicks, more and more Georgia are gravitating toward Brad’s conservative leadership, his tested record, and how much he cares about the future of our state—not his political career.
Brad is listening to concerns about affordability, public safety, and education, and is translating those conversations into concrete policy proposals to keep Georgia strong and competitive.
---
[|
---](https://BradForGeorgia.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb0b5d8f4cac8238170f7992f&id=f6aafc3029&e=6036811227)
| |
**Atlanta Journal-****Constitution****: Tax Cuts**
_Secretary of State Brad Raffensperger, a_[ _Republican candidate for governor_](https://BradForGeorgia.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb0b5d8f4cac8238170f7992f&id=a9f02c7d5b&e=6036811227) _, announced today he wants to eliminate Georgia’s income tax on retirement benefits._
_Raffensperger said a retiree withdrawing $100,000 a year would save roughly $5,000 annually at the current state income tax rate._
_“For decades, Georgia retirees have been punished for doing the right thing,” Raffensperger said. “They worked hard, saved responsibly, paid their taxes, and then the government comes back for another bite when they are on fixed income. That ends when I’m governor.”_
_Under current law, Georgia taxes retirement distributions at the state income tax rate but offers a retirement income exclusion of $35,000 for those ages 62 to 64 and $65,000 for those 65 and older. The state does not tax Social Security benefits._
Read the entire article [**HERE**](https://BradForGeorgia.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb0b5d8f4cac8238170f7992f&id=6c23a7ea85&e=6036811227).
---
|
---
| | | | | | | | | | | | **The Center Square: Raffensperger goes beyond election controversy in gubernatorial campaign**
Brad sat down with The Center Square to talk about the campaign and all he’s doing to keep Georgia affordable and safe.
_"We were pursued by Stacey Abrams and her allied groups over 10 times and I met her and beat here and her allies in court every single time because our laws were right, they were good laws.”_
_“We stood up and protected SB202 which was the Election Integrity Act of 2021. We lost an All-Star Game over it. We actually ended up having a higher turnout in 2022 and even a higher turnout in 2024.”_
_"Actually, what I'm really hearing about, people are concerned about their pocketbook issues. That's why when I run for governor, I am focused on what they are focused on and I am the best person to solve that."_
Read the entire interview [**HERE**](https://BradForGeorgia.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb0b5d8f4cac8238170f7992f&id=ae0c2fc31f&e=6036811227).
---
|
---
| |

Brad had the pleasure of speaking at the Citizen Impact Pastors & Ministry Leadership Day. He shared his faith, family background, and track record of standing up for conservative principles.
As your next Governor, Brad will always protect religious liberty and defend the shared values that strengthen our communities and our state.

If you believe Georgia should remain the No. 1 state to live, work, and do business, now is the time to step up.
Join Team Raff today to support our grassroots efforts, help deliver real results for hardworking families, and be part of the movement building a stronger, more affordable, and safer Georgia.

Together, we will Make Georgia Affordable.

Friend, Last week I brought an incredible Black Muslim immigrant to the State of the Union: **Dr. Fatou-Seydi Sarr** , who founded and leads the **African Bureau for Immigration & Social Affairs (ABISA).** At the State of the Union, Trump spread racist lies about Black immigrants—a community already targeted by ICE across the country. I spoke up to call out these lies. And Dr. Sarr and I made it clear: we aren't going anywhere. ABISA's staff and volunteers are themselves impacted by ICE violence and anti-Black immigration enforcement. They challenge anti-Black rhetoric and uplift Black immigrants’ stories, **and shift the narratives about who belongs here and who is seen as worthy of protection**. Through the**Black Immigrants Bail Fund** , ABISA also tracks ICE arrests in real time, supports families in navigating immigration court, and raises emergency funds to secure people’s release from detention. ABISA’s life-saving rapid response work is paired with policy advocacy and collective power-building—**affirming the rights and dignity of Black immigrants** , while working toward long-term transformative goals such as ending immigration detention. When bond was set at $10,000 for Mor Ba—a 19-year-old who was torn from our community and detained in a for-profit facility known for its abuses—ABISA raised $12,000 to secure his release and fund reentry stabilization services.
**Each bond posted interrupts the trauma of detention, keeps families intact, and sends a clear message: no one navigates this alone.**
To ensure that Black immigrants are connected to national infrastructure rather than isolated in local fights, **ABISA coordinates national rapid response networks**.
In my community and across the country, ABISA **empowers newly arrived Black immigrants** through leadership development, culturally grounded ESL classes that center community dignity, and participatory education that helps community members understand their rights, the immigration system, and the structures shaping their lives in the United States.
These programs affirm the expertise and lived knowledge that immigrants already carry—building their leadership, agency, and full participation in civic life.

When ICE abducted teenagers from our community, **ABISA led the successful effort to release 19-year-old Detroit resident Mor Ba**.
I visited him at the detention center where he was being held every week. When his bond was set at $10,000, ABISA raised $12,000 in emergency funds—covering his release and supporting his reentry.
That’s the kind of life-saving work that ABISA does around the country.

From **providing free assistance through the Black Immigrants Bail Fund** , to coordinating low- and no-cost legal representation and helping families navigate immigration courts, ABISA’s rapid response work is necessary—especially at this moment.
This week at the State of the Union, Trump specifically bragged about targeting Black immigrants, which ICE is doing in Minnesota, Maine, and beyond.
I spoke up against his racist lies and his dangerous expansion of law enforcement, an institution that’s already rooted in anti-Black racism.
**ABISA fights back. They challenge anti-Black and anti-immigrant rhetoric** , humanize immigrants and reframe migration as _resilience_ rather than _criminality_.
Immigration is not a crime, and ABISA pushes back against enforcement-first immigration policies, while**advocating for policies that protect and affirm the dignity of Black immigrants**.
Led by Black immigrant women who are directly impacted by ICE violence and are witnessing increased cruelty and terror, ABISA works toward transformative changes such as**ending immigration detention** , and convenes national response networks to detention crises.
ABISA **empowers newly arrived Black immigrants** —honoring their expertise while building the confidence, agency, and tools they need to fully participate in their communities.

clean_body: Our attorney general candidates are ready to take Trump to court | = Peter, Just months into his second term, Donald Trump moved to impose sweeping tariffs and push federal control over our elections. And a year later, his threats to both our economy and our democratic systems have only escalated: Repeated threats to "nationalize" elections. Unconstitutional tariffs that put Americans' livelihoods at risk. Deploying ICE officers to pressure states into handing over voter rolls. = | = As we get closer to November, Trump is ramping up his efforts to interfere in the midterm elections – and we know why: he's desperate to cling to power. But the authority to administer elections, prosecute fraud, and uphold the rule of law doesn’t run through the White House. It runs through the states — and through the Democratic pro-choice women serving as attorneys general. clean_body: Tomorrow could be the day the Supreme Court strikes at the heart of the Voting Rights Act. | | Peter, BREAKING: Supreme Court watchers are reading the signs—and it appears that the MAGA justices could gut the Voting Rights Ac tas soon as tomorrow. The Court has yet to issue a ruling in Louisiana v. Callais , the case that could disenfranchise millions of Black and Brown Americans, gut voting rights, and allow rampant racial gerrymandering in the 2026 midterm elections. Our sources have long expected the Court to weigh in on Callais in time to influence the midterms in favor of Republicans. And the Court just announced a new decision day for tomorrow, March 4th. Our coalition of activists, experts, and allied organizations are ready to mobilize the minute the Court decides on Callais. We’ve got materials prepared, rapid response ready, and organizing planned. The Supreme Court is supposed to look out for the people. But all the signs are pointing to their focus being squarely on influencing the midterm elections in favor of their MAGA handlers. If the MAGA justices tear down the Voting Rights Act in Callais, it’s not just Louisiana’s maps that will be skewed red. Every other red state attempting to draw partisan, racially gerrymandered districts ahead of the 2026 midterms will have the green light to do so. The Court’s decision on this one case could amount to one of the biggest attacks on our democracy and voting rights in the modern era. And their decision could affect us and alter the balance of power toward authoritarianism for decades to come. That’s why United for Democracy has been working behind the scenes for weeks preparing for this decision to drop. When it does drop, we’re stepping into center stage. Our allies, organizers, and experts are ready to fight back. Are you? Today marks exactly eight months until Election Day

Hey Derek — today marks exactly eight months until Election Day. Eight months to spread the word about Josh’s record to every corner of Pennsylvania. Eight months to outwork, outhustle, and outsmart the far-right. Hillary

Brandon Herrera

Most 401(k)s and IRAs remain heavily concentrated in stock-heavy portfolios that depend on stability.

A newly released 2026 report explains:
• Why AI-driven momentum can mask deeper risk
• How debt amplifies downturns
• What a 30-40% reset could mean for retirement savers
• How some Americans are diversifying beyond stocks

# [Dollar soars as Gold dips after Middle East war rally](https://substack.com/redirect/4a010564-8efa-40f0-a310-a833d10a34a1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Gold **[plunged more than 4.5% Tuesday](https://substack.com/redirect/4a010564-8efa-40f0-a310-a833d10a34a1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after a four-day safe-haven surge, as escalating US-Israel-Iran conflict in the Middle East spiked energy prices and inflation fears, bolstering the dollar and delaying Federal Reserve rate cuts that pressure non-yielding bullion.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/4a010564-8efa-40f0-a310-a833d10a34a1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Dollar surges sharply** : A stronger US dollar gained about 1.5% this week, amplifying pressure on gold as higher interest rates loom from conflict-driven inflation risks.
* **Inflation threats mount** : Middle East war has driven energy price spikes reminiscent of 2022 Ukraine conflict, raising US manufacturing input costs and Fed caution on easing.
* **Analyst warns parallels** : Commerzbank expert highlights 2022 precedent where oil-fueled inflation strengthened the dollar and weakened gold throughout the year amid rate hikes.
* **Volatility hits metals** : Precious metals face high volatility and liquidity strains from rising prices triggering margin calls and position liquidations in risk-off trading.

---|---|---
* **Defense Boom Accelerates** : Palantir's roughly half government revenue gains validation from U.S. military strikes on Iran and threats under Trump, positioning the company for expanded adoption.
* **Major Contracts Secured** : Recent wins include a $10 billion U.S. Army deal for AI tools and a $100 million Maven Smart System contract enhancing battle management.

# [Iran drone strikes Qatar LNG halts production shock](https://substack.com/redirect/befe170c-9904-423c-977c-029874f45d0f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Iranian drone **[attacks on Qatar's key LNG facilities forced a production halt](https://substack.com/redirect/befe170c-9904-423c-977c-029874f45d0f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Monday, sending European natural gas prices surging 35% amid fears of prolonged Strait of Hormuz disruptions and a potential repeat of the 2022 energy crisis hitting Europe and Asia hardest.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/befe170c-9904-423c-977c-029874f45d0f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Qatar Production Pause:** QatarEnergy suspended LNG output at Ras Laffan and Mesaieed after Iranian drones struck, slashing near-term global supply by roughly 19%.
* **Strait Hormuz Closure:** Iranian forces blocked the vital chokepoint handling one-fifth of global LNG trade, stranding tankers and heightening supply squeeze risks.
* **Europe Price Surge:** Benchmark TTF futures jumped 35% to over 60 euros per megawatt-hour, up 76% weekly, exposing the continent's 25% LNG reliance.
* **Asia Vulnerability Highlighted:** Major importers like India, China, Japan face severe exposure, with Goldman Sachs warning of prices nearing 74 euros amid growth and stagflation threats.

# [OpenAI rushes Pentagon deal then scrambles to ban domestic surveillance](https://substack.com/redirect/f09695d1-809b-47bd-acf2-e489fa7adb91?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
OpenAI CEO Sam Altman admitted the company's hastily announced defense contract with the Pentagon **[appeared"opportunistic and sloppy"](https://substack.com/redirect/c4271eca-e066-4710-8a3b-025bfd4d19ff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** amid backlash, prompting quick amendments to explicitly prohibit using its AI for intentional domestic surveillance of U.S. persons and bar intelligence agencies like the NSA from accessing the tools without further changes.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c4271eca-e066-4710-8a3b-025bfd4d19ff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Altman Regrets Rushed Timing:** OpenAI's leader acknowledged the original Friday deal announcement looked opportunistic amid the Pentagon's fallout with rival Anthropic, saying he shouldn't have rushed it and aimed to de-escalate tensions.
* **Key Amendment Language Added:** New contract wording states AI systems "shall not be intentionally used for domestic surveillance of U.S. persons and nationals," explicitly covering deliberate tracking via commercially acquired personal data.
* **Intelligence Agency Restrictions:** The Pentagon affirmed OpenAI's services won't be used by agencies like the NSA, with any future access requiring a separate contract modification.
* **Broader Safety Commitments:** Amendments reinforce OpenAI's principles against certain military uses, noting the tech isn't ready for some applications and aligning with shared red lines on surveillance and safety tradeoffs.

# [Anthropic blacklisted as US bombs Iran with its AI](https://substack.com/redirect/c4271eca-e066-4710-8a3b-025bfd4d19ff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Tech workers at[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/c4271eca-e066-4710-8a3b-025bfd4d19ff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[Google and OpenAI rallied against military AI use Tuesday](https://substack.com/redirect/c4271eca-e066-4710-8a3b-025bfd4d19ff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after the Pentagon blacklisted Anthropic for refusing mass surveillance and autonomous weapons roles, just as U.S. strikes hit Iran amid escalating fallout.
* **Tech Backlash Ignites:** Nearly 900 employees from Google, OpenAI, and peers signed "We Will Not Be Divided" letter demanding ethical limits on military AI contracts amid DoD pressure tactics.
* **Anthropic 's Defiance Stands:** Company designated supply chain risk by Defense Secretary after rejecting unrestricted use of Claude models for surveillance or fully autonomous weapons, sparking solidarity petitions.
* **Google Faces Scrutiny:** Alphabet in talks to deploy Gemini AI on classified Pentagon systems, reviving internal concerns echoing past revolts over Project Maven and Nimbus contracts.
* **Geopolitical AI Irony:** U.S. military reportedly used Anthropic's Claude for intelligence, targeting, and simulations in Iran strikes hours after Trump's ban, highlighting challenges in phasing out embedded tech.

# [Elliott drops a billion on Pinterest](https://substack.com/redirect/1c6028bd-26b7-4ae1-88b0-5f1edd5299c4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Activist investor Elliott Management **[poured $1 billion into Pinterest](https://substack.com/redirect/1c6028bd-26b7-4ae1-88b0-5f1edd5299c4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** via convertible notes Tuesday, fueling a massive $3.5 billion share buyback program as the image-sharing platform's stock surges amid year-long declines.
* **Elliott 's Major Stake Boost:** Elliott, already a top shareholder, buys $1 billion in 1.75% convertible senior notes due 2031 at a $22.72 conversion price, a 30% premium to recent levels.
* **Massive Buyback Launch:** Pinterest authorizes new $3.5 billion repurchase program, targeting $2 billion in first-half 2026 actions including $1 billion accelerated repurchase starting March 5.
* **Strong Confidence Signal:** Elliott partner Marc Steinberg, on Pinterest's board, expresses "strong conviction" in the company's future trajectory and substantial growth opportunities ahead.
* **Stock Reaction Immediate:** Pinterest shares jumped around 6-10% in trading following the announcement, countering a nearly one-third value drop year-to-date.

subject: Yes, I’ll Impeach. Yes, I’ll Abolish ICE.
body:
LA Deserves Courage. Abolish ICE.

| | | | | [|
---](https://chrisahuja.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=67424df89870d1cac00e55f46&id=90f2e5e151&e=53c7d12fc7)
| | | | | | Dear Peter,
I’m proud to share that our campaign has been endorsed by [**Courage for Democracy and Citizens’ Impeachment**](https://chrisahuja.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=67424df89870d1cac00e55f46&id=51c1be9efe&e=53c7d12fc7) as part of a nationwide slate of more than a hundred Courage Candidates.
**Here’s what that means: if elected, I will honor my oath.** I will move to impeach Donald Trump for tyranny, treason, and obstruction of justice — including the ongoing Epstein files cover-up — at the first opportunity.
**The Constitution provides a remedy for lawlessness. It’s called impeachment.** Members of Congress swear an oath to defend our democracy. That oath is a responsibility, not a suggestion.
Right now, that oath is being tested again. An unconstitutional war is being waged on Iran without proper Congressional authorization, without transparency, and without accountability to the American people. The power to declare war belongs to Congress. It does not belong to one man acting alone. Sending our troops and resources into another endless conflict without debate or authorization is not strength. It is a direct violation of the separation of powers that protects our democracy.
**Here in Los Angeles, this fight is not abstract**. Our communities have been directly harmed by aggressive ICE raids and unlawful seizures that tear families apart and spread fear through immigrant neighborhoods. That is not public safety. It is political intimidation.
Courage means confronting corruption at the top. It means stopping unauthorized wars abroad. It also means abolishing ICE and protecting immigrant families right here in CA-32.
**Brad Sherman has had decades to act.** He’s chosen caution. Our district deserves representation that will not flinch when the Constitution — and our communities — demand action.
If you believe in impeachment. If you believe Congress must reclaim its constitutional authority over war. If you believe in abolishing ICE. If you believe LA families deserve protection and not politics — I’d be honored to have you with us.
[**If you’re able, please consider chipping in $20, $50, $100, or whatever feels right to help us reach more voters and build the coalition it will take to win.**](https://chrisahuja.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=67424df89870d1cac00e55f46&id=43ee58a877&e=53c7d12fc7)
**Every contribution moves us closer to an America that upholds its Constitutional values.**

**➤➤ URGENT: Trump spreads fake 2020 map and demands arrests** **[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126568414/605303471/38783915?refcode=em-3.3.26-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTkxNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNmNiNDUzOC0zMzE3LWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2ExZjBhOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8-HpEFdC9ThApkJJT9M0eo8BfRJS2i_v5MitfL8JtnM=)**
* * *
He’s at it again, friend. Donald Trump just shared a fake 2020 electoral map online — _one that falsely shows him winning states he clearly lost_ — and used it to call for arrests over the last presidential election. Six years later, Trump is still pushing debunked conspiracy theories about 2020,**and now he’s pairing them with threats of criminal prosecution.** This isn’t just about the past. Trump is laying the groundwork to challenge, and potentially refuse to accept, future election results. We’ve seen this pattern before:
* First, claim fraud without evidence.
* Then, spread misinformation to millions.
* Then, demand prosecutions.
* Then, pressure officials to overturn outcomes.

| | | | High school dropout. Waffle House waitress. First woman to graduate from The Citadel. Single mom. Fighter.

Nancy Mace wasn’t born into power. She worked for every inch of ground she’s gained.

At 17, she dropped out of high school and took a job slinging hash browns at Waffle House to survive. No silver spoon. No Ivy League connections. Just grit, grace, and a whole lot of graveyard shifts.

By the grace of God, she turned that struggle into a story no politician can touch. She made history as the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, South Carolina’s legendary military college. She built her own business. She raised two kids on her own. And when the Left came for everything she believed in, she stood her ground. Now, she’s running for Governor of South Carolina.

Nancy Mace is a battle-tested conservative who’s walked through fire and come out swinging. In Congress, she’s been one of President Trump’s fiercest allies, fighting to secure our border, protect our daughters, and stop the Left’s sick agenda dead in its tracks.

She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history.

Nancy is fighting to:

* Eliminate South Carolina’s Income Tax—the highest in the Southeast

* Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency

* Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free

* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate

* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think

* Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front.

South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.

Let me back up and give you the full story...

Back in 2018, the Left convinced Utah's voters to (barely) approve a cleverly worded ballot initiative named Prop 4.

To voters, it sounded harmless._It wasn 't. _

Prop 4 took redistricting power away from elected lawmakers and voters... and handed it to an unelected "independent" commission.

_Translation? _

A backdoor way to carve out a Left-wing seat in Congress in deep-red Utah. A quiet map-rigging operation.

And for weeks, the headlines screamed that the effort to repeal Prop 4 was doomed to fail.

_" They don't have the numbers"... "They can't get enough signatures"... "It's too late." _

That's what they said.

But the Left and their parrots in the media forgot something...

They forgot about the patriots in Utah who had already been working diligently for months. They forgot about the grassroots.

**And they forgot about what happens when Turning Point Action dives into a fight. **

Well above the 141,000 signature threshold needed to place the repeal of Prop 4 on the ballot.

We didn't just hit it. _We blew past it. _

To be clear, signatures are still being verified. And the Left is already working overtime to pressure signers to remove their signature and sabotage the repeal effort.

ABC: House Republicans propose stricter voting requirements as Trump administration eyes the midterms [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=030326_2&amount=25]
Folks, we've been warning you about the SAVE Act since it was introduced, since it's a stunning assault on our fundamental right to vote.
Well, there's a new champion in the " anti-voting legislation " category with the introduction of the Make Elections Great Again (MEGA) Act. The new bill goes far beyond even the SAVE Act, with the MEGA Act now being called " the most extreme voting restrictions ever proposed at the federal level ."
The name also tells you everything you need to know about the target audience for this bill. With Trump focused on re-litigating the 2020 election, this legislation would give him all the power he would need to take federal control of the upcoming midterms .
PITCH IN $35 RIGHT NOW TO STOP THE MEGA ACT ➜ [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=030326_2&amount=35]
While the SAVE Act focused almost exclusively on requiring voters to produce documentary proof of citizenship when registering, the MEGA Act is far more sweeping. It would:
* Impose a strict photo ID requirement to vote
* Create a centralized voter surveillance system in every state
* Mandate constant voter roll purges, gutting the “Motor Voter” law that expanded access to voter registration
* Bar states from counting ballots that arrive after Election Day
* Ban universal mail voting, in which states mail a ballot to all registered voters
* Bar the federal funding for voter registration by outside groups
* Unleash lawsuits against election officials
Estimates said the SAVE Act could disenfranchise up to 11 million eligible Americans , especially women and those who live in under-resourced communities. The MEGA Act would be much, much worse.
Team, the consequences of a bill like this passing would be catastrophic for our democracy. Chip in with $35 or whatever you can today to stop the MEGA Act and other voter suppression bills from becoming law >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=030326_2&amount=35]

The scariest parts of the MEGA Act are how it goes after so much more than proof-of-citizenship at registration. States aren't mandated to provide ID to eligible citizens, but the MEGA Act would require citizens to show the right kind of ID every time they went to vote. This creates inequality, like in Texas, where you can vote with a hunting license ( which doesn't require proof of citizenship ) but you can't vote with a college photo ID.
This bill targets voter registration as well, demanding that eligible voters re-prove their citizenship every election, while also requiring states to " take affirmative steps... on an ongoing basis " every 30 days to check and verify their voter rolls. How would they check them? Using a nationwide federal database controlled by MAGA partisans, of course . And the bill calls for all these measures to be in place before we vote in November's general election.
“ There’s never been an attack on voting rights out of Congress like this ,” said Alexander Keyssar, a professor of History and Social Policy at the Harvard Kennedy School, and a leading historian of voting rights said about the SAVE Act. “ It’s always been the federal government trying to keep states in check on voting rights, for the most part. ”
His words ring even more true about the MEGA Act. This bill is nothing less than an all-out partisan assault on our fundamental right to vote . If made law, this bill would codify MAGA's power for decades to come, invalidating millions of eligible voters and ending our democracy for a generation or longer.

The name also tells you everything you need to know about the target audience for this bill. With Trump focused on re-litigating the 2020 election, this legislation would give him all the power he would need to take federal control of the upcoming midterms .
