Hi Peter,In the coming weeks, we begin one of the most important parts of our campaign: knocking doors across Johnson County.
There’s been a lot said lately about rankings, statistics, and how strong our local economy looks on paper. And while we can appreciate the progress our county has made in some areas, the numbers presented by the current guard don’t tell the full story of what families are experiencing day to day. They don’t explain rising property tax concerns, questions about rapid development and rising costs of living, or the feeling some residents have that decisions are being made without any community access or input.
That’s why I'm dedicated to going directly to the source, you.
Door knocking isn’t just a campaign activity. It’s how we make sure leadership reflects real conversations, not curated messaging. When I show up at your doorstep, I am not delivering a speech. I am asking questions. I am listening to what’s working, what isn’t, and where the county government can do better.
I want to talk about responsible growth that protects neighborhoods, planning how to grow in a way that actually keeps pace without overburdening taxpayers, public safety that supports both families and first responders, and fiscal discipline that ensures long-term stability for our county.
This campaign is about keeping Johnson County strong economically, but also as a place where residents feel heard, respected, and confident in their local leadership. That only happens when engagement comes first.
If you believe the county government should have more community input and accountability, I would love for you to join this effort. Whether you can walk with me for an afternoon, help organize others in your neighborhood, or support the outreach effort with a donation to pay for palmcards and yardsigns, your involvement makes a huge difference.

There is just one week left until the special election to fill the seat vacated by Marjorie Taylor Greene.
20 Republicans are running.
One Democrat is running.
I am that Democrat.
This is how we win.
This is how we take back the House and put a check on Trump's warmongering rampage against our democracy.
I’m Shawn Harris. Democrat. Husband. Father. Retired Brigadier General. Farmer. And I’m running to represent Northwest Georgia with the seriousness, steadiness, and leadership it’s been missing for years.
We need a surge of support by midnight to meet our fundraising goal. Will you split a donation between my campaign and Tobias Read? subject: Our democracy is not for sale

body:
[ https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20260303-5957-footer&t=1001&akid=5957%2E420207%2Epwv3tN ]Pramila Jayapal

Peter, I’m furious.
This is not the news I wanted to share today.

AIPAC is gearing up to pour millions of dollars into the Democratic
primaries to take down progressive candidates — again.

[ https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260303-1.kQ3aAP&refcode=em20260303-5957&t=1002&akid=5957%2E420207%2Epwv3tN ]AIPAC accused of covert campaigning as Democratic support falters

They’re targeting progressive leaders who dare to actually do their jobs,
and refuse to be bought or intimidated. AIPAC is exploiting campaign
finance loopholes to flood the primaries with their millions, doing
everything they can to drown out the voices of our people-powered
movement.

That’s why I’m launching an emergency fund to help candidates who are
being hit with these attacks. This fund will help candidates respond, stay
competitive in the face of big money, and keep their campaigns on track so
they can focus on winning and standing up for their communities.

[ https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260303-1.kQ3aAP&refcode=em20260303-5957&amount=3&t=1003&akid=5957%2E420207%2Epwv3tN ]I’ll tell you more, but first, can you pitch in $3 to
support our emergency fund to fight back against these attacks?

[ https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260303-1.kQ3aAP&amount=3&refcode=em20260303-5957&t=1004&akid=5957%2E420207%2Epwv3tN ]Donate

We’ve seen the kind of damage AIPAC can do before. In New York, they spent
over $24 million to unseat Jamaal Bowman, turning his race into the most
expensive House primary in history. They did the same thing to Cori Bush,
they’ve gone after my sister, and targeted me.

No progressive candidate is safe from their massive warchest and their
willingness to weaponize it against our democracy.

Even more alarming: The billionaire donors fueling AIPAC are the same ones
who bankrolled Trump’s return to office. And now they’re trying to meddle
in the Democratic primaries.

When that kind of money crashes into a race, it distorts the entire
election. It buries people-powered campaigns under an avalanche of attack
ads, and forces candidates to spend time defending themselves instead of
focusing on what really matters: speaking to the issues that working
people face.

We can’t stand by while AIPAC tries to dictate the primaries. Elections
should be decided by voters, Peter,
not whoever can write the biggest check.

Our emergency fund will make sure progressive candidates have the
resources to fight back immediately, and protect the integrity of our
primaries before big money can tip the scales.

[ https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260303-1.kQ3aAP&refcode=em20260303-5957&amount=3&t=1005&akid=5957%2E420207%2Epwv3tN ]If you’re with me, pitch in $3 today so we can send a
message to AIPAC loud and clear: Our democracy is not for sale. The people
hold the power to pick our leadership, not them.

[ https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260303-1.kQ3aAP&amount=3&refcode=em20260303-5957&t=1024&akid=5957%2E420207%2Epwv3tN ]Contribute $3

AIPAC is gearing up to pour millions of dollars into the Democratic primaries to take down progressive candidates — again. [ ]AIPAC accused of covert campaigning as Democratic support falters They’re targeting progressive leaders who dare to actually do their jobs, and refuse to be bought or intimidated. AIPAC is exploiting campaign finance loopholes to flood the primaries with their millions, doing everything they can to drown out the voices of our people-powered movement. That’s why I’m launching an emergency fund to help candidates who are being hit with these attacks. This fund will help candidates respond, stay competitive in the face of big money, and keep their campaigns on track so they can focus on winning and standing up for their communities. [ ]I’ll tell you more, but first, can you pitch in $3 to support our emergency fund to fight back against these attacks? [ ]Donate We’ve seen the kind of damage AIPAC can do before. In New York, they spent over $24 million to unseat Jamaal Bowman, turning his race into the most expensive House primary in history. They did the same thing to Cori Bush, they’ve gone after my sister, and targeted me. No progressive candidate is safe from their massive warchest and their willingness to weaponize it against our democracy. Even more alarming: The billionaire donors fueling AIPAC are the same ones who bankrolled Trump’s return to office. And now they’re trying to meddle in the Democratic primaries. When that kind of money crashes into a race, it distorts the entire election. It buries people-powered campaigns under an avalanche of attack ads, and forces candidates to spend time defending themselves instead of focusing on what really matters: speaking to the issues that working people face. Warrior Mom: A Guidebook for Families

Warrior Mom: A Guidebook for Families on the Autism Journey

For many parents, the autism journey begins with questions, uncertainty, and the desire to find meaningful ways to support their child’s health and development. Warrior Mom: A Mother’s Journey in Healing Her Son with Autism was written to serve as a guidebook for families navigating that path. Through personal experience, practical insight, and years of research, the book offers encouragement and direction for parents seeking to better understand underlying health factors and whole-body approaches.

Families often share that the book helps them feel less alone while giving them tools to advocate, ask informed questions, and explore supportive strategies that may improve their child’s quality of life. It is not just a personal story, but a resource designed to empower parents with perspective, education, and hope as they move forward in caring for their loved ones on the spectrum.

State bill creates new path for school discrimination complaints, sparks debate over harassment standard
| | | | [](https://link.email.joinrmv.-LQ/s9qfd3978bd)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.joinrmv.-LQ/s3jedb45225)**
| | Hi friends,
Listen to today's Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.joinrmv.-LQ/s7gb3d913a9), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.joinrmv.-LQ/s9q2a2328a8) or [Rumble](https://link.email.joinrmv.-LQ/s0g3393c4c9). Here is a summary of today's top stories:
🏛️ **Under the Golden Dome...** HB26-1141 advanced on a 9–3 vote, creating a new state process for [school discrimination complaints](https://link.email.joinrmv.-LQ/s9mc746ec02) and adopting a harassment standard that does not require conduct to be “severe or pervasive,” but must interfere with access to education. Supporters call it a needed backup to federal enforcement; critics warn it could blur the line between discrimination and protected speech. The $800,000-plus bill now heads to Appropriations.
🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** Major firms relocating are adding to the [debate over the state’s business climate](https://link.email.joinrmv.-LQ/seia3d2222a), wolf depredation claims have [surpassed $1 million](https://link.email.joinrmv.-LQ/s4rbb953fc6), and an [ICE operation in Lakewood turned violent](https://link.email.joinrmv.-LQ/s6r6ba674aa) after a suspect rammed federal vehicles and fled. House Bill 26-1141 cleared the House Education Committee last week on a 9–3 vote and now moves to the Appropriations Committee before it can reach the House floor. The proposal would create a state-level process for handling discrimination complaints in K–12 schools and higher education.
Complaints would go through the Colorado Civil Rights Division. The agency could investigate, try to resolve cases through mediation, and, if necessary, allow a case to move into court.
The proposal covers claims tied to legally protected characteristics — or even the perception that someone belongs to one of those groups. The categories aren’t new. They’re the same ones already written into Colorado’s civil rights law — race, religion, disability, sex, sexual orientation, ancestry, national origin, creed, and, more recently, gender identity and gender expression. Lawmakers added those last two in recent years through bills such as HB25-1312.

Peter,

**Americans spend just 8–12 seconds** on an email before deciding whether to read or delete it. I’m asking for a little more of your time today—because what’s at stake for our country couldn’t be higher.

My name is Adam Schwarze. I’m a 20+ year veteran: U.S. Marine infantryman turned Navy SEAL (Ret.), with nine deployments across more than 70 countries.

_**On September 11, 2001, I was an 18-year-old in Bloomington, Minnesota, watching the Twin Towers burn.**_ That day changed everything. I raised my right hand, swore an oath to defend this nation, and spent two decades carrying Old Glory into harm’s way—from frozen Minnesota streets to the sands of Iraq, the mountains of Afghanistan, and villages we liberated from ISIS tyranny.

I’ve watched our flag fly proudly over freed lands. I’ve seen it folded and presented to grieving Gold Star families who paid the ultimate price. **I’ve lived the cost of freedom—and I’ll never forget why we fight. But today, America feels like a different battlefield.**

**Working families can’t afford groceries while Washington elites get richer.

Our borders are wide open, fentanyl floods in, and politicians look the other way. **

**Our kids are falling behind as radical ideologies erode the values we hold dear.**

_This isn’t the America I risked my life—and lost brothers—for._

That’s why I’m running for the United States Senate in 2026. Not for a title or a career in politics. The fight didn’t end when I left the service. I don’t know how to quit, and I’m not afraid of a tough battle—just ask our enemies.

[**please join my team today

Minnesota’s U.S. Senate seat (held by Tina Smith) is now open for the first time in years. Republicans haven’t won it since 2008. But with strong national momentum and an energized base, this is suddenly winnable—if we build the resources to introduce my story statewide before the August primary and beyond.

The problem? I’m a first-time candidate, virtually unknown to most Minnesotans outside my service record. The Democrat machine will dump tens of millions to hold this seat and push their agenda. I can’t self-fund, and I won’t back down.

_**That’s where you come in.**_

clean_body: The Clintons just defied Congress—again. | Peter, Americans spend just 8–12 seconds on an email before deciding whether to read or delete it. I’m asking for a little more of your time today—because what’s at stake for our country couldn’t be higher. My name is Adam Schwarze. I’m a 20+ year veteran: U.S. Marine infantryman turned Navy SEAL (Ret.), with nine deployments across more than 70 countries. On September 11, 2001, I was an 18-year-old in Bloomington, Minnesota, watching the Twin Towers burn. That day changed everything. I raised my right hand, swore an oath to defend this nation, and spent two decades carrying Old Glory into harm’s way—from frozen Minnesota streets to the sands of Iraq, the mountains of Afghanistan, and villages we liberated from ISIS tyranny. I’ve watched our flag fly proudly over freed lands. I’ve seen it folded and presented to grieving Gold Star families who paid the ultimate price. I’ve lived the cost of freedom—and I’ll never forget why we fight. But today, America feels like a different battlefield. Working families can’t afford groceries while Washington elites get richer. Our borders are wide open, fentanyl floods in, and politicians look the other way. Our kids are falling behind as radical ideologies erode the values we hold dear. This isn’t the America I risked my life—and lost brothers—for. That’s why I’m running for the United States Senate in 2026. Not for a title or a career in politics. The fight didn’t end when I left the service. I don’t know how to quit, and I’m not afraid of a tough battle—just ask our enemies. Minnesota’s U.S. Senate seat (held by Tina Smith) is now open for the first time in years. Republicans haven’t won it since 2008. But with strong national momentum and an energized base, this is suddenly winnable—if we build the resources to introduce my story statewide before the August primary and beyond. The problem? I’m a first-time candidate, virtually unknown to most Minnesotans outside my service record. The Democrat machine will dump tens of millions to hold this seat and push their agenda. I can’t self-fund, and I won’t back down. That’s where you come in. Together, we will: Secure the border: Welcome legal immigrants who love America; deport criminals and stop the chaos. Revive our economy: Cut wasteful spending, unleash energy independence, and restore dignity for working Minnesotans. Empower parents: Put them back in control of education, not bureaucrats or radicals. Defend the Constitution: Every word, every right—no compromises. I’ve carried our flag into the fight before. I’ve seen what it stands for. And I will never stop defending it—for Minnesota, for our kids, for a stronger, prouder America. Hi team,
If you've been following along, you know it's petition season here in Pennsylvania. We are two weeks into a three-week sprint to get enough signatures to get on the ballot.
I have been blown away by the support from our community.
One woman called up a county party office and asked someone to bring my petition outside - she struggled to walk, but she had driven 20 minutes to come to the office and help me get on the ballot.
Another volunteer walked her tiny borough, getting all 27 of her Democratic neighbors to sign our petition.
Campaigns are a funny thing - the candidate matters, sure, but it's the people who show up, who join the team, that really make or break each moment.
**I 'm so proud to be part of this team. But we're not done yet.**
That's why we need **everyone** for this final push. If you can, come out this weekend and help us cross the finish line strong.
**We would love to see you at one of our events. Whether you join us for a canvass event or drive a friend to sign the petition, every signature gets us closer.**
[ Join us this weekend!](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/1d6f652e-1923-43d6-981f-66bfe1fe8581?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
And if you can't make it out, you can still make a real difference. [Please consider chipping in a few dollars to help cover caffeine and pizza for our hardworking staff and volunteers who are putting in long days and long drives to get this done.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/85c5eaf5-e8ab-4be7-b22f-d86674e5293c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Let's make this last week count!
Thank you,

We are two weeks into a three-week sprint to get enough signatures to get on the ballot. I have been blown away by the support from our community. One woman called up a county party office and asked someone to bring my petition outside - she struggled to walk, but she had driven 20 minutes to come to the office and help me get on the ballot. Another volunteer walked her tiny borough, getting all 27 of her Democratic neighbors to sign our petition. Campaigns are a funny thing - the candidate matters, sure, but it's the people who show up, who join the team, that really make or break each moment. I 'm so proud to be part of this team. But we're not done yet. That's why we need everyone for this final push. If you can, come out this weekend and help us cross the finish line strong. We would love to see you at one of our events. Whether you join us for a canvass event or drive a friend to sign the petition, every signature gets us closer. And if you can't make it out, you can still make a real difference. Let's make this last week count! Thank you, Rachel Thanks for reading! Hi there! I wanted to introduce myself. I’m Kalliana, and I’m Sue’s campaign manager.

Yes — I’m also a college student. I’m grateful Sue is providing me the opportunity to work on her campaign! And yes, it’s a lot of coffee and Google Calendar reminders. But I wouldn’t trade this experience for anything. It wasn’t always my plan to get into politics, but I couldn’t pass up the opportunity to work for someone as dedicated as Sue.

It’s more important than ever for young people to come together to elect leaders who truly have our futures and best interests at heart, especially as we watch our national leaders drag us into yet another war in the Middle East.

So when Sue and I first sat down to talk about this campaign, I had a question for her.

I asked: _Why this office? Why Lieutenant Governor?_ I wanted to know what she actually believed the job was for.

Sue didn’t give me a rehearsed answer. She talked about the responsibility of the office — how it can be used to elevate and tackle complicated issues that aren’t getting enough attention, to build coalitions, to support small businesses, to create real transparency in state government. She talked about accessibility. About being visible. About doing the unglamorous work well.

Guys, I was so impressed. I couldn’t wait to get on board.

As a young Rhode Islander, I care deeply about the future of our state. I care if there is going to be an opportunity here for me in the future, and I care if our leadership actually reflects the values of this state. I’m forever asking questions about how we can be better.

Sue takes those kinds of questions very seriously.

Over the next few weeks, we’re inviting people across Rhode Island to send in their questions about the Lieutenant Governor’s role and what big issues they want to see this office tackle.

**[If you have one, I hope you’ll share it with the team. I know Sue would love to hear from you!](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3865u5P-T9YITnie-ESWxWXrlDLv6wmj_pBkmXxvJgZC3Yw5g0LSNsiwmuUs8edZe-lJsj2zApT-MkajCXKAxjRmuwP9j-puSuoP959H5t1RVj0Wtj9_opxgwYuvefMGKNWijuL7qCW4vxRGhCt3ZQyDitQ57sd0UByuzGK-cTNpW6tmMNRWDdfGX6RDoVEaolWXjuqTUV3M0BbFPbP8hteLvL4UyyI_20bzPHGBoKW4qi8CDebqCwA5Q9UaYjufGfUSLTnpu8BSeXz1IUKBEpEdDY35zwpFxvcHeH1grKraQ0fsWTyUrGY0iCsS6i6rOEQoa2BIE2f58Z-50cMmpcx/4om/cpr44OgoQbOSnEMCA-da_A/h0/h001.Pk5WxbRzROHmcP72CWidoHQBGEBZmJ3ffjhqGSmEHjk)** | | [ **SUBMIT YOUR QUESTION** ](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3865u5P-T9YITnie-ESWxWXrlDLv6wmj_pBkmXxvJgZC3Yw5g0LSNsiwmuUs8edZe-lJsj2zApT-MkajCXKAxjRmuwP9j-puSuoP959H5t1RVj0Wtj9_opxgwYuvefMGKNR-WXsSHYDr4BEZkRAOk1REzjG0-aM_o1He1CsShrr36wXGcK_bPIC0Qjfl9J9T95WWQsjTNBlveaNx83HT8KLLnz7S5ikjz9GQ7sru_CVe-BIH7Qkq_IVa7LZ3fFynbkSbHcCYERy_5P9Xou025kXwskVInbQnG-tlVYGpcU1IEsnJiY4MiOhylalvT58zoWOH113UTwr2dTRcgqjHtIA/4om/cpr44OgoQbOSnEMCA-da_A/h1/h001.g-9IH4yllgRoa_o8RpeIECz1cx7q5jwUywrX1Bo1CWY)

If I close my eyes, I can still see all the people I protested the Iraq War with when I was a kid--in high school or on the campus at the University of Nebraska at Omaha--laying small American flags down on the field to remember the fallen. I can still remember being in the crowds protesting around Carter Lake with the handmade signs, the chants for peace, and that feeling that maybe, just maybe, we could stop something catastrophic from happening.
A lot of us were just kids who believed our country would eventually learn from its mistakes.
And now I'm sitting here, stuck on my couch recovering from surgery, watching horrific images out of the Middle East again, and I feel like I've been dropped back into 2003. It's the dumbest time loop imaginable--except this time we know exactly how the story ends, and we're marching anyway.
I say this a lot, and people roll their eyes at me sometimes, but it keeps being true: every Republican president in my lifetime has crashed the economy and dragged us into a Middle East war. And Donald Trump is no different. In fact, he may be the first to do it twice, given the state of the American economy. And what's maddening isn't just that it's happening--it's that we've seen this exact movie before.
It's so abundantly clear to me, after watching these press conferences and these attempts by Trump and Hegseth and Vance and the rest of his administration to explain this, that they have no idea what the hell they're doing--no defined objective, no clear authorization from Congress, no exit strategy, and no honest explanation for the American people. They have no plan in Iran. They have no plan to explain it to the American people. They have no exit strategy. They are just being dog-walked by Bibi Netanyahu, and that's not right.
Our United States military should never be sold out to other countries in this way. I believe in a strong military. I believe there are moments when force is necessary. But if you cannot clearly explain the mission, define victory, and tell the American people why their sons and daughters might die--you have no business starting a war.
And then I'm watching the callous way that the Trump administration is talking about those who have already lost their lives. And by the way, I do not believe for a second that this administration is being forthcoming with the number of American military personnel who have been killed in the last couple of days, because we've seen this before--minimized numbers, delayed disclosures, and families finding out the truth after the headlines move on. It's maddening. It's the kind of thing that should turn 100% of Americans against this administration.
And to be honest with you, I recognize that we'll never have 100%, but I do think there is a growing coalition of people who are just fed up and fucking done with Donald Trump and his administration and his people--domestically, in foreign policy, culturally. These people have got to go. And you see that fatigue basically everywhere now including throughout MAGA world.

* * *
This is a president who has lost the plot, lost the vast majority of the American people, and even the people who are supposed to prop him up--the MAGA influencers, the Matt Walshes of the world, Megyn Kelly of all people, who are soulless and will just say whatever--even they are breaking right now because they can't justify or defend these actions.
And unfortunately, we're trapped with these guys for another three years. I get these comments all the time when I post this stuff: we're not impeaching him. We're not invoking the 25th Amendment. We're stuck with these assholes for three more years. That's reality, and I wish it wasn't. I simply cannot imagine a situation where we would be able to have the votes to remove this president and Vance and everybody else.
However, I do foresee a scenario where we elect a strong Democratic Party in 2026 and 2028 that holds these people accountable. Because even now, as I think back as a millennial to all the things that I've experienced--from the Iraq War to 9/11 to the Wall Street financial crisis to the COVID pandemic to all of these moments where a powerful class of wealthy people have steered our country over a cliff while making more money and gaining more access and more power for themselves, the Epstein files being the other obvious example--nobody's ever been held accountable.
Moment after moment, powerful people drove the country into a ditch and somehow came out richer and more powerful. And no one at the top ever pays a price. The pattern is always the same: chaos for everyone else, insulation for the elite.
Well, goddamn it, if I have anything to say about it, here's the only way out of the loop: win power--and more importantly, use it to permanently rein in executive war authority. Restore Congress's constitutional role. Require real authorization before sustained military action. Demand automatic transparency on casualties. Make it structurally harder for any president to freelance a war like this. We're going to build a Democratic Party that holds people accountable. We're going to drag these fuckers in, and we're going to hold them accountable for this illegal war that they've put together and more (re: Epstein).
We have to make sure that we rein in this power. We can't have an unfettered executive with no Congress to hold them accountable. We have to reassert that authority, and it starts with electing the right kind of Democrat in November. And I hope you go out and find one that you believe in, because that's when I'll get out of bed in the coming days and be useful again. That day is coming sooner, I pray, because I'm sick and tired of fucking sitting here recovering from this surgery.
That's what I'm going to be doing with it, and I hope you do it too, because that's the only way to channel this anger. Power shifts under pressure. And although it's exhausting, we have to keep applying it. There's a major shift happening in our country--and persistence is how we reach accountability.
We're out of power right now, but we will not be out of power for long. And then it's a matter of how we use that power when we take over. And I'm ready to see Democrats use that power in a way that's in line with where this country is, where this country needs to go, and the group of people we need to break and destroy if we're ever going to get this country back on track.

Tim Walz

I am the proud son of Vietnamese immigrants. My parents fled communism to America with nothing. It was anything but easy -- but they persevered and chased the American Dream. They opened a small corner store in Southern California where I spent my summers behind the register.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126574252/605320537/-1429052514?refcode=em-3.3.26-all-b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDg3ODciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMDRiZmY5ZmEtM2YxNy1mMTExLWE2OWEtMDAwZDNhMWYwYTk3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=RKl5PRBP2PT8VeTJYGOGX2MirNlAagpJ1yzIjwCbgu8=)
_My mom at our corner store._

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126574253/605320538/-1429052514?refcode=em-3.3.26-all-b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDg3ODciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMDRiZmY5ZmEtM2YxNy1mMTExLWE2OWEtMDAwZDNhMWYwYTk3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=RKl5PRBP2PT8VeTJYGOGX2MirNlAagpJ1yzIjwCbgu8=)
**It was never my plan to run for Congress. But when I saw an opportunity to serve my community, I didn’t think twice. We defied the odds and flipped this Republican stronghold by a margin of 653 votes in 2024.**

Now, I’m gearing up for my first re-election, and you can bet that GOP challengers are coming out of the woodwork to flip CA-45 back to red and expand the MAGA House majority.

**[That’s where you come in: I’m fighting hard in Congress against corruption to bring back results for working families, and my seat is once again ranked as one of the most competitive nationwide. _**By David Shuster**_
There are scandals. There are obscenities. And then there is the filthy criminal coverup being carried out by the Trump White House and the U.S. Department of Justice. Remember the Epstein files?
Just a few days ago, BEFORE Trump bombed Iran, the Epstein coverup was a leading argument for Trump's impeachment and removal from office. Going to war without Congressional approval though is right up there. I'll get to the Iran strikes later this week. In this column however, I want to return your focus to Trump-Epstein.
Let me be direct. We now know that a woman came forward in 2019 alleging that, as a minor, she was sexually assaulted by Donald Trump and Jeffrey Epstein.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/da148c87-cb90-4c81-a08e-6d309ced8854?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Investigators did not laugh her out of the Federal Bureau of Investigation. They interviewed her four times. Four. In the careful, plodding world of the FBI, that is not a courtesy; it is an acknowledgment of credibility. Agents summarized each session in the bureaucratic catechism known as an FBI 302 report.
Three of those summary reports are now missing.
Not delayed. Not misfiled. Missing.
The public got it's first inkling of this coverup from investigative reporter Roger Sollenberger on Substack.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/da148c87-cb90-4c81-a08e-6d309ced8854?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Then, the story was confirmed and broadcast on NPR. And now, it has been corroborated and splashed on the front page of the New York Times - that cautious matron of American journalism, which does not fling accusations like confetti.
The Times reporting is simple and devastating: key materials tied to the rape allegation against Donald Trump were not included in the DOJ's Epstein document release.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/da148c87-cb90-4c81-a08e-6d309ced8854?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The excuses keep changing. First, DOJ officials said the records were privileged or duplicative. Then, the DOJ suggested the files could be part of an ongoing investigation. An investigation of whom? Certainly not of Mr. Trump. Now, the DOJ is says it will review if the files were improperly withheld.
Meanwhile, the President is bellowing that he has been "totally exonerated," chanting the phrase as if it were a charm against any scrutiny.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/da148c87-cb90-4c81-a08e-6d309ced8854?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
On Air Force One, Trump used the phrase three times in thirty seconds. In some circles that is called emphasis. In others it is called panic and consciousness of guilt.
Here is the crucial point, and it is not complicated. Congress passed, and Mr. Trump signed the Epstein Files Transparency Act. It permits redactions only to protect victims' identities--nothing more--unless materials are part of an active investigation.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/da148c87-cb90-4c81-a08e-6d309ced8854?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
That is the law as written, not as wished. If there is no active investigation of Mr. Trump, then the withholding of these interview summaries stands in open defiance of the statute.
Even more grotesque: while materials potentially embarrassing to Trump and his friends have been blacked out or withheld, the names of actual Epstein victims were, in multiple instances, unredacted. So, the victims were violated again, this time by the Trump administration's carelessness or contempt. Meanwhile the mighty, including Trump, remain swaddled in protective ink.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/da148c87-cb90-4c81-a08e-6d309ced8854?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Attorney General Pam Bondi once declared that she possessed the so-called Epstein client list and would release it. She assured Fox News it was on desk.
The disclosure never happened. And Bondi's public vows of transparency have dissolved into an administration fog.
Add to this the testimony of Justice Department whistleblowers who allege suppression of incriminating photographs and videos... and the picture ceases to resemble incompetence. It has become obstruction.
If the missing FBI memoranda exonerated Donald Trump, the administration would trumpet the documents from every government podium and platform in Washington, D.C. The Trump family would reprint the FBI 302's on commemorative coins, cards, and plates and sell them to MAGA collectors.
The absence of such a Trump triumph establishes vulnerability, not vindication.
This is not a close call. It is not a matter for delicate parsing. When credible allegations of child sexual assault against a sitting President produce multiple FBI interviews--and the summaries of those interviews vanish while his Attorney General controls their release--the stench is not subtle. It is overpowering.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/da148c87-cb90-4c81-a08e-6d309ced8854?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Our nation cannot endure selective transparency. We cannot demand exposure for the weak and discretion for the strong. If laws requiring disclosure are ignored, they are not laws at all.
So the time has come for action. Whether it's a House impeachment and Senate trial, or demands that Trump resign, something must be done.
The underlying principle is simple: A President credibly accused of monstrous crimes, whose administration withholds relevant evidence in clear violation of the statute, is not "totally exonerated." Donald Trump and Attorney General Pam Bondi have engaged in a criminal coverup. Their behavior qualifies as a "high crime or misdemeanor."
If members of Congress decline to act -- --if they prefer redaction to reckoning--then they are accomplices to ending the rule of law.
Trump must be removed from office.
Enough already.
Was the Iran war an attempted Trump distraction? More on that later this week.

body:
# [](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/8?t=1&akid=1235%2E1086043%2E-pIMAL)
Peter, the Trump administration is trying to sever the relationship between the federal government, our states, and our people.
But despite the headwinds coming from Washington, Democratic leaders like Wes Moore are fighting for safer communities, better education, and more jobs in our states.
That’s the kind of progress we must continue -- no matter what chaos comes from Donald Trump. **Democratic governors are _the_ crucial line of defense in this moment, and they need our support to stay in the fight.**
**[Will you chip in $5 or any amount to the Democratic Governors’ Association today? Your donation will help support Democratic governors across the country.](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260303-1.Vjw6Mb&refcode=em-20260303-1&t=2&akid=1235%2E1086043%2E-pIMAL)**

Instead of working hand-in-hand with state and local leaders, President “Twitter Fingers” has been firing off posts on Truth Social trying to blame Governor Moore for the Potomac Interceptor collapse -- even though it occurred on federal land under the President’s purview.

While the President points fingers online, Governor Moore has been clear: this is about protecting people, not playing politics. His administration has been on the ground since Day One -- coordinating with D.C. officials and federal agencies, deploying the Maryland Department of Emergency Management, containing the spill, and conducting ongoing water sampling to keep Marylanders safe.
Democratic governors know that leadership means showing up, taking responsibility, and doing the work. There has never been a more important time to elect more of them.
**[Please, support Democratic governors across the country with a contribution today.](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260303-1.Vjw6Mb&refcode=em-20260303-1&t=23&akid=1235%2E1086043%2E-pIMAL)**

Team Wes Moore

Democratic governors know that leadership means showing up, taking responsibility, and doing the work. There has never been a more important time to elect more of them. Thanks for everything, Team Wes Moore

name: Jim Schultz
subject: The Minnesota Business Community Must Step Up in 2026
body:
A DFL Trifecta Would Be a Catastrophe

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/44967cb68468/the-briefing-from-mpbc-13059214?e=baf210d431)
---
| | | | |
---
| |
Minnesota is heading toward a defining election this fall, and the business community—and all Minnesotans—cannot afford to misunderstand [**what is at stake**](https://growthmn.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e307c9beec837f7456d65a5e6&id=5b1de938c5&e=baf210d431)**.**
**Minnesota’s economy is on life support.** Today Minnesota ranks in the bottom 10 states in nearly every metric. If the DFL gains another trifecta, they will **increase the top tax rates by 25% or more.** They will pass crushing regulatory burdens. They will redistrict the state’s legislative and congressional maps to secure DFL control long-term. And they will reject meaningful steps to combat fraud.
The business community must not be lulled into a false sense of security by Amy Klobuchar. **The assumption that a “moderate Democrat” will govern like one has been tested repeatedly in Minnesota, and it keeps failing.** Tim Walz ran as a centrist. Once empowered by a DFL trifecta, he delivered the most liberal governing record in Minnesota history.The hard truth is that **the modern DFL machine isn't grassroots.** It is bankrolled by out-of-state progressive billionaires and others who are massively outbidding Minnesota's own private employers.
**In 2026, business leaders face a binary choice: Either invest now, seriously and historically, or accept political and policy irrelevance later.** Leaders who create jobs and opportunity must engage to match the scale of the threat they face.
The full argument — and what it asks of Minnesota business leaders — is worth your time. [**Read it here at growthmn.com**](https://growthmn.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e307c9beec837f7456d65a5e6&id=61adf2c744&e=baf210d431)**.** Working with you, **Jim Schultz** President & CEOMinnesota Private Business Council **P.S.** For $100 a year, you stop watching from the sidelines.****[**Main Street Members of the Minnesota Private Business Council**](https://growthmn.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e307c9beec837f7456d65a5e6&id=b72597b760&e=baf210d431)**** get real-time alerts on legislation, insider polling on Minnesota's political landscape, and principled advocacy showing up in St. Paul when you can't.**** That's less than $10 a month to be part of the organized private-sector counterweight this state desperately needs — at the exact moment it needs it most.**** The out-of-state progressive billionaires funding the DFL machine aren't waiting.****[**Join MPBC here**](https://growthmn.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e307c9beec837f7456d65a5e6&id=32c4303b17&e=baf210d431)**.**

Comprised of privately held businesses from a broad array of Minnesota industries, the Minnesota Private Business Council advocates for policies leading to job growth, new business creation and entrepreneurship, and broad-based well-being for Minnesota’s workers and their families. # [](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/629?refcode=em20260303-260&t=1&akid=260%2E12592%2Es7mnE0)
ICYMI:
**Donald Trump’s political team is running the campaign against us in Virginia.**
Reporting has confirmed that national GOP operatives tied to Trump are pouring resources into Virginia to stop our campaign to vote YES on free and fair elections.
The group is run by Trump’s former state directors, RNC operatives, and Republican power brokers. They’re deliberately confusing voters by backing a misleadingly named group — _Virginians for Fair Maps_ — to cling onto control of our congressional elections.
Let us be clear: **They are opposite to us. This is a Trump-backed attempt to harm democracy and keep politicians, not voters, in charge.**
We can’t let their money and misinformation decide the outcome.
We’ve been on the front lines, pushing back against false claims and making sure Virginians understand what this vote actually does — and why it’s one of the most critical decisions facing the Commonwealth this year.
**But we can’t take on the GOP’s national machine alone.**
**[If you believe Virginia’s elections should belong to voters — not Trump’s political insiders — chip in $3 right now to help us fight back:](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/41?c0=em_ms_vafe_20260303_2.F4RuxV&amount=3&refcode=20260303-260&t=2&akid=260%2E12592%2Es7mnE0)**
**[Donate $3 ››](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/41?c0=em_ms_vafe_20260303_2.F4RuxV&amount=3&refcode=20260303-260&t=21&akid=260%2E12592%2Es7mnE0)**
_We have just**3 days** until early voting starts this Friday_. Every moment counts.
Thank you,
Virginians for Fair Elections

[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_vafe_2026_footer?refcode=em&t=22&refcode2=260_12592_s7mnE0&akid=260%2E12592%2Es7mnE0)
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way we keep in touch with people like you, so thank you for reading to the end.

Israel Invades Lebanon After Hezbollah

Israel authorized the IDF to [advance into Lebanon](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJycUDmOpTAUPI3JjLywBg4mIfuTToiM_fg8yTwj24D0Tz-iW32BTkoVlGr795pfFgPS-6_dwbgLZx_9fGZLHnOyEOISsECyBTBZmpVQHReaCz1TmGXljfOdVhUY2feq7eUoZbUZ38Hih7EbfNPr3skWQK9iGKReB7-2XYXmcRJaaCVFK8Zajo3zblgHJdzY9iNrxHl4WyDXLlKGdNmCFyBRfFik2sW9CmYr5chM_2FqYmq677teEmBZbCqPgqkJzhQPYGp6EpmahP6B74U82JPcBpkjXTZjJB5XHmCxFImXyD2sQJ47LPgBynxNcecbfJYYgt2Ymqpk_HFjCJi7njXivVsMX_3KLy69jPofAAD__-2php4) and seize strategic positions along the border on Tuesday after Hezbollah broke the 2024 ceasefire to attack northern Israel in retaliation for Khamenei's death. Defense Minister Israel Katz vowed Hezbollah would pay a [heavy price](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckD2ynDAQhE8DmaiRtIsgUOCEbJ06pAZpWKasH0powcd38d4NXtYddHd9_ec1v5ADp_dvjGTdybPPfv4cmDwfBSnkJXClgpW4YJoVqF6AFqDnFGbZeut8r1VLVhqjnkaOUrabhXUZFtLGgOkBe8R-XP0Ay7IQmQGoZXs3gQatJDxh7OT4cN4N66DAjU8zNg_47B4rHZ3L6aByYuWTOKV8q5w6l2Mb7FbrfjT6V6OmRk3XdXVr_pfoumOxUVPgk8TtGzXdBOLCImr5xF18A4q_G0ZKxCJicZtQbbF-vzgEPnrTPOAdkcPXWv3BQadV_wMAAP__mV12-Q) for firing rockets into the Galilee. The IDF struck over 70 Hezbollah targets in Beirut and southern Lebanon overnight, killing a Palestinian Islamic Jihad commander and a Hezbollah intelligence chief. Israel also debuted a new [laser defense weapon](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckD2u5SAMRldDOiIwN38FxTTp3rRTRg4471oiEAFJ9HY_ypVmA9NYlmzZ5zt_vpYv5MDx-zfuZN3Fi09-OQtGzyUjhbQGrpSxEmeMCyjopTJSmSWGRTfeOt8baMjqYYBu0JPWzdvipMw2TrgOau06WEmZzfQjAOhR9ePasH0uKaMMaNWpqdXTy3k3biMoN3XDJF7qPDxWKq1LsVC-sPJFHGN6uhRbl_Ym2HetRxHml4BZwHzfd7tm4rpirs-GgJnOnA4SMD8fBczK_CuBL7o5k0zHk5BTlHSwk9uZf6THH7mlM8v6JhkekCoj3UVuOe3ykSEx-s90Z-8DScJSBcxNtv64OQQu_SBe6ntHDh_a-h-CLwt_AwAA__-cYIrQ) reported to be a game-changer for shooting missiles out of the sky. ★★★
Epic Fury Devastates Iran's Military

Operation Epic Fury entered Day Four with CENTCOM confirming U.S. forces have struck over [1,250 Iranian targets](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckL9u9CAQxJ_G7rAA_y8ovua6-9qU1hqW80oYLgu2ozx95DxCutFIM5r5fTyXJ1Cg-PoPOxp70uKSW44M0VFmwJDWQAUZChJDXLTUg5CtkO0Sw6JqZ6wbWl2jUeOo-1HNStWbGSwiauv94NB3cu3t5Nt-mGZUU69nV5O5m2QrW61kL-dGzZ11dvKTlnbux7nq5PF2UDA3NsWMfEKhEynGdKsUG5v2OpitlHeu2n-VflT6cV1X49NXxOuO7beTOLhKPzwxZsHwQnEfyWKF6IAFrCtkEeGEIDYE93kAF-QscmGgIrbE-_EtCoP3ZEUuEAK6mo17XxQC5WGsOvnagcLvovIHiKfRPwEAAP__H-iFfQ) in 48 hours, including IRGC headquarters, ballistic missile sites, and naval assets. **OFFICIAL PRESS RELEASE** **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE****United Republicans Officially Endorses Mike Lindell for Governor of Minnesota****March 3, 2026** The national grassroots organization United Republicans, led by Founder and Chairman Tony Noun, proudly and officially announces its full endorsement of Mike Lindell for Governor of the State of Minnesota.Mike Lindell is not a career politician. He is a businessman, job creator, constitutional advocate, and a man who has demonstrated resilience, faith, and unwavering commitment to the American people. At a time when Minnesota is facing serious challenges — rising crime, economic uncertainty, government overreach, and loss of public trust — bold leadership is not optional. It is required.United Republicans believes that Minnesota deserves:• Law and order restored• Protection of constitutional freedoms• Transparent and accountable government• Economic growth driven by American industry• Leadership that answers to the people — not political insidersMike Lindell has consistently stood for election integrity, free speech, faith, and American values. He has built businesses, created American jobs, and shown the courage to speak when others remained silent.Tony Noun, Founder of United Republicans, issued the following statement:“Minnesota does not need another career insider. It needs a fighter. Mike Lindell has proven he will stand when others kneel. He understands business, he understands the Constitution, and he understands the people. United Republicans is proud to stand with him and support his campaign for Governor.”This endorsement reflects United Republicans’ broader commitment to strengthening states across America by supporting leaders who prioritize citizens over bureaucracy and freedom over control.United Republicans calls upon all freedom-loving Minnesotans to unite behind Mike Lindell and work together to restore accountability, prosperity, and confidence in Minnesota’s future.Together, we will make Minnesota strong again.

name: Senator Ruben Gallego
subject: We can’t let them send more American kids to die
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
Young American men and women are dying because a bunch of complete idiots haven’t put any real thought into what they are doing and what the consequences are going to be.
#

I remember in 2002 when Netanyahu testified before Congress that invading Iraq would be a great result for the middle east.
20+ years later, apparently we didn’t learn shit. We just followed Netanyahu into a war with Iran. We are making the same exact mistakes, and the same thing is happening.
Young American men and women are dying because a bunch of complete idiots haven’t put any real thought into what they are doing and what the consequences are going to be.
As someone who fought in Iraq, who lost some of my best friends over there, this is hitting me hard. I know it’s hitting other veterans just as hard. This Sunday my mom was telling me how difficult it was for her when I was in Iraq. Not knowing for days at a time if I was hurt, or dead.
Honestly, it’s not easy. But that’s why this moment matters.
I came back pissed off, and I fought for a place at the table. I wanted our leaders to listen to the people they sent off to die in an illegal war. I am in the United States Senate today to make them hear us.
We have a chance tomorrow to stop this from escalating any further. The Senate is going to go on record, we’re going to vote, and the American people are going to see who wants to send their kids to die and who doesn’t.
I need you to add your voice.
[**Peter, if you’re against sending another generation of working class American kids to die in somebody else's war, please: Endorse the Iran War Powers Resolution.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/signup/260303-WPR-EM/?refcode=em260303-1-120&akid=4085%2E734936%2Et2LtEy)
[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/signup/260303-WPR-EM/?source=em260303-1-120&akid=4085%2E734936%2Et2LtEy)
Thank you.
Ruben

That’s not right.
**No matter where you live, where you’re from, or what kind of job you hold, every New Mexican deserves to be heard and to see their needs reflected in the decisions that shape their lives.** As governor, I’ll lead the way I always have: listening first and fighting for the people who don’t have a seat at the table. **_[I’m running to represent all New Mexicans and give a voice to those who don’t have one. Please, will you chip in $5 to my campaign for governor so I can deliver progress to working families across our state?](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/5906?refcode=jtk276-fr-nd&t=2&akid=7933%2E400544%2EdGvcJ1)_**

We deserved elected officials who care about what matters to us. I’ll never forget what one person told me when I was going door knocking in the Pueblos to try to engage more Indigenous communities to vote. clean_body: We deserve elected officials who care about what matters to us. | | | Friend, Since I first stepped into public service, I’ve known why I’m here: To make sure the people who’ve been overlooked finally have a seat at the table. Too often, the loudest voices and biggest donors set the agenda, while working families, rural communities, and folks just trying to get by, like I once was as a single mom, are left out. That’s not right. No matter where you live, where you’re from, or what kind of job you hold, every New Mexican deserves to be heard and to see their needs reflected in the decisions that shape their lives. As governor, I’ll lead the way I always have: listening first and fighting for the people who don’t have a seat at the table. | | Like my mother and her mother, I have always felt a deep responsibility to my state and our communities — it’s how and why I got my start as an Organizer. Growing up, I saw firsthand how Native American voters were so often forgotten in the political process — and I knew we deserved better. We deserved elected officials who care about what matters to us. I’ll never forget what one person told me when I was going door knocking in the Pueblos to try to engage more Indigenous communities to vote. He said,"I've always wanted to vote, but I never knew how." Over the years, I have helped register hundreds of Native Americans to vote, friend, and I'm immensely proud of the work I’ve done to empower people from all walks of life to use their voice. But New Mexico’s Indigenous communities are not the only ones that are being left behind — there are countless working families who don’t feel heard or supported. If mobilizing our Indigenous communities to vote taught me anything, it’s that people want elected leaders who will listen, fight fiercely for them, and understand what they are going through. That’s why I'm in this race to deliver meaningful change for working families so that everyone can thrive — | | Thank you, Deb | | | | |

# From the desk of Senator Drew MacEwen
---
| | | | | |
Did you know the most competitive congressional race in the country is happening right here in Washington State?Washington’s 3rd Congressional District — in Southwest Washington — is currently represented by a Democrat, but it has a long history of supporting Republicans for president and statewide office. This November, we have a real opportunity to flip this seat with a responsible, business-friendly Republican: my longtime colleague and friend, Senator John Braun.I’ve served alongside John in the Washington State Senate for many years, and I’ve seen firsthand the kind of leader he is. John is the Republican Leader of the State Senate and has consistently worked to lower taxes and push back against the most extreme policies coming out of Olympia. As a small business owner, John understands how taxes and regulations affect employers, workers, and families.This district was represented by Republican Jaime Herrera Beutler until 2022, when a divided primary allowed an unexpected Democrat victory. That will not happen again. John is uniting Republicans and offering steady, serious leadership — not sound bites or political theater, but thoughtful, long-term solutions.I know John well. I trust his judgment, his character, and his commitment to public service. Peter, we’re fed up. President Trump and his Republican allies keep repeating entirely disingenuous and misleading talking points on the SAVE Act. Their lies are putting the rights of millions of voters at risk. This isn't just a voter ID bill. Republicans, in their desperate attempt to undermine the will of the people, are glossing over some really critical facts. **The SAVE Act is a deliberate effort to make it extremely hard to vote.** Under the bill that passed the House and is now waiting on a vote in the Senate, a regular driver's license wouldn't be enough to register to vote. A REAL ID wouldn't be enough. Military IDs wouldn't be enough. Heaven help you if you got married and your paperwork doesn’t have your updated legal name. Just to register to vote, this bill would require documentary proof of your citizenship — something that tens of millions of Americans can’t access easily. [**The NDRC refuses to let Trump and his MAGA allies take over our elections. With the midterms looming, we need your help to fund our most urgent efforts to respond.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126576217/605327207/-1096702678?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_FactCheckMAGA_email_20260303-NDRC-Tier1-FactCheckMAGA_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20260303-NDRC-Tier1-FactCheckMAGA_&utm_campaign=FactCheckMAGA&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImU4YWIyMmJlLTQ3MTctZjExMS1hNjlhLTAwMGQzYTFmMGE5NyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=bzecHQFgMZE9bKq0W0A63fXOzLmfboz8gnh7CI8_kKc=) It’s incredibly anti-democratic to force millions of eligible voters to jump through unnecessary hoops just to exercise their rights. Trump, in his State of the Union speech, called voting “the greatest privilege of them all” — and that tells you all you need to know. **Because voting in America isn’t a privilege — it’s a right. ** This administration has demonstrated time and again that they don’t care about democracy. They’re trying to change the rules and redraw maps in the months before a national election — they know they can’t win unless they silence voters. **We must do everything we can to protect voters and democracy, especially as Republicans are willing to use every scheme in the book to cling to power.** [**The NDRC is fighting back against the SAVE Act and the other mounting attacks on our democracy. name: Ilhan Omar
subject: "They got money for wars, but can't feed the poor"
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ILHAN FOR CONGRESS
body:
We’re at war with Iran, and we’re paying for it.
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=2115%2E791427%2EbHBGst)
_"They got money for wars, but can't feed the poor"_ — Tupac Shakur.
A quote as true now as it was when it was written over 30 years ago.
Friend, the biggest legislative “achievement” of Trump’s second term was passing the Big Ugly Bill. That bill did a few major things:
* Kick at least 11 million Americans off their Medicaid healthcare plans

* Double, on average, insurance premiums for 5 million Americans who have Affordable Care Act healthcare plans

* Kick at least 4 million Americans off food assistance programs that help them feed their families

* Greatly lower taxes for the ultra-rich

Well over **a trillion dollars** was taken out from under low-income families, who rely on these programs just to get by, in order to “pay for” lower taxes for billionaires like Elon Musk, Jeff Bezos, and Donald Trump.
In the same year, Republicans pushed through a defense budget that totaled $900 billion — the largest military funding package in history, and about the same amount that was cut from Medicaid just months earlier.
Now, we’re at war with Iran, and we’re paying for it. Not just with lives, but with our hard-earned tax dollars, too. Just like we did with the war in Iraq and Afghanistan, which experts say cost between _$4 and $6 trillion._
**If we have the money to destroy foreign countries and drop bombs across the world, we can absolutely use that money to invest in the American people and make life more affordable instead.**
As we oppose this illegal, reckless, and destabilizing war with Iran, it’s important to remember that a better world is possible. But to see that world, we need to get rid of our war-hungry leadership and reset our nation’s priorities: Healthcare, housing, and education, not death, destruction, and regime-change.
That remains my north star as a member of Congress, and the dream of this progressive movement. Let’s keep up the fight.
In solidarity,
— Ilhan
* * *

**We know times are tough right now.**
But if you can afford it, consider chipping in to Ilhan’s campaign. We’re quickly approaching our first FEC deadline of the 2026 election year, and we want to show that there’s massive grassroots support behind Ilhan’s campaign to end this needless war with Iran and deliver on affordability for the American people. body:
Demi Palecek and Robert Peters are showing us what leading with integrity truly looks like.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260303-1&t=1&akid=3210%2E587540%2EQUOEMW)
Peter,
I recently took a trip to Illinois, and I can’t stop thinking about the courageous leaders and inspiring young people I met there — and why we do this work.
I had the chance to spend time with **Demi Palecek** and **Robert Peters** , two leaders who are showing what it looks like to lead with integrity. They roll up their sleeves and tackle the issues their communities are facing head-on.
When I was on the ground with Demi, what stood out to me wasn’t just the number of young people that showed up (though that alone was incredible), it was the campaign model she’s building there. Too often, campaigns call on young people to make calls or knock doors for them in a way that feels purely transactional.
Demi is doing something _completely_ different.
She’s creating opportunities for people to plug in and directly support their communities. This isn’t just about work that’s beneficial to her campaign — Demi is mobilizing volunteers to build mutual aid networks, feed neighbors who are afraid to go to the grocery store because they’re being targeted by ICE, and organize around needs that truly strengthen their community long before any election.
She’s willing to fight right alongside the people she represents. That’s _exactly_ the kind of leadership we need in Congress.
[](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260303_1_illinois.BQdlne&refcode=em20260303-3210&t=2&akid=3210%2E587540%2EQUOEMW)
**That kind of leadership builds trust. It builds relationships, and those relationships create movements of young people who see politics not as a seasonal performance, but as an investment in their future.**
The next day, I stood alongside Robert Peters and coalition partners at a press conference about the RIFL Act, legislation that he’s helping lead in the Illinois state Senate. This bill would make waves — taxing the gun industry and requiring it to shoulder the financial burden from the harm it’s profited off of by funding victim services, funerals, and providing long term support that families need in the aftermath of gun violence. He’s creating concrete change that directly serves his community.
[](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260303_1_illinois.BQdlne&refcode=em20260303-3210&t=3&akid=3210%2E587540%2EQUOEMW)
**Seeing leaders like Demi and Robert in action and so many young people energized to be a part of this work reaffirmed why what we do matters so much.**
Winning elections is important, but so is building our movements, creating trust, and showing that real, lasting change starts with people stepping up to help their neighbors. That’s how we challenge power and build a better party, and country.
**[If you’re able, can you pitch in $5 today to elect bold young leaders like Demi and Robert who are committed to serving their communities, and taking bold action on the issues that matter most?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260303_1_illinois.BQdlne&refcode=em20260303-3210&amount=5&t=4&akid=3210%2E587540%2EQUOEMW)**

Thank you,
David Hogg

body:
# [](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/43706?t=1&akid=240727%2E444211%2Eblvf_A)
I was at Texas Southern yesterday and had so many good conversations about voting and a lot more.
Someone asked me about going to war with Iran. He told me it hits him differently now that he’s 18 and doesn't like where we’re headed.
I had a long talk with a future architect about urban design and walkable neighborhoods and why it’s so hard to live in Houston if you don’t have a car.
I talked to pre-law students about what happens when you have a president who defies the constitution, pre-med students about making it easier for people to get help even though we are the least insured state in America, and saw education majors about to enter the teaching profession too.
I met a recent grad who at age 18 was elected to the school board in Port Arthur and is now 4 years later running for city council. He also helped lead TSU-UH walk to the polls, hundreds of students from these two powerhouses joining forces to get it done.
So many good people, it gives you hope.
In every conversation, we brought it back to voting and winning political power so we can make things better.
[**If you can afford it, will you donate $3 to help keep me on the road and support the work our organizers and volunteers are doing each and every day?**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20260303-2.1JxBvr&refcode=ema20260303-240727&t=3&akid=240727%2E444211%2Eblvf_A)
I am so grateful to every single person who chips in to make our work possible.
Thank you,
Beto

| VIRGINIA IS FOR PATRIOTS!

| Hamilton HeadlinesI hope you are all enjoying some warmth after the snow! Things continue to move fast in Richmond. We have two weeks left and we are beginning to get a better idea of what exactly will land on Governor Spanberger's desk to either sign or veto.
---
|
---
Pray for our Troops! I would like to start off with a call for prayer for our Armed Forces, and our National Leadership, given the recent events with Iran and the Middle East. My husband served as a Navy SEAL Combat Veteran, and the cost of war is very personal for my family, as I'm sure it is for many of you also. Let's keep these brave Americans in our daily prayers until they all return home!
Session Updates
* Democrats have introduced Virginia HB 1524 which proposes to prohibit the open carry of certain semi-automatic center-fire rifles, pistols, and shotguns as well as other modified firearms.

* Democrats have introduced SB 783 from the Virginia Senate which prohibits Virginia Law Enforcement from cooperating with Immigration Enforcement authorities.

* Democrats also voted to almost triple their salary, after proposing more than 50 tax increases.

* Democrats have committed to rejoining the Regional Greenhouse Gas Initiative (RGGI), which is a cap and trade program to limit carbon emissions.

THIS WILL PUNISH ALL VIRGINIANS WITH HIGHER ENERGY COSTS DUE TO THE DEMOCRATS' EXTREME CLIMATE AGENDA!
|
---
Some Good News! There is some good news, however...due to the immense public backlash...most of the proposed direct tax increases were shot down either in committees or on the floor. MORE GOOD NEWS! All Sheriffs in the 62nd District (Orange, Culpeper, Madison & Greene) have reaffirmed their commitment to upholding our second amendment rights! THEY WILL NOT BE ENFORCING THESE UNCONSTITUTIONAL LAWS! I could not be more proud of the stance taken by these men of honor and public service. District 62 is in good hands! YOUR VOICES HAVE BEEN HEARD...PLEASE DO NOT STOP PUSHING BACK AGAINS THIS RADICAL AGENDA! Tracking these bills as they are brought to the floor can be difficult. If you want to follow these bills as they are presented to the Virginia House and Senate, and track votes, [click here to go to the Legislative Information System website](https://hamiltonforvirginia.com/so/e2PoiJ8Rd/c?w=v_IrghIOLPkn5XKUfSOosKBXdji99WRmHG3Ph_JQw5E.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9saXMudmlyZ2luaWEuZ292LyIsInIiOiIiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiI0NDI4ODkzMy1lNGNjLTRmMTItOGYzZS02ZjQ1ZjM3NjIxZjQifQ).
|

Gerrymandering Update! The vote for redistricting is set currently for April 21st, with early voting beginning on Friday, March 6th! A Virginia trial court blocked the April 21, 2026, referendum on the proposed constitutional amendment allowing mid-decade congressional redistricting, however this only applies to Tazewell County. Democrats have boldly stated that this effort is in retaliation to other state legislative actions. The legal fight is ongoing. The Supreme Court of Virginia is expected to give their ruling in April, AFTER the referendum. They will likely side with the voter....so we need to show up in massive numbers and with this at the polls! Key Developments:
* Court Action: A Tazewell County judge blocked the referendum, ruling that initial legislative votes on the amendment were invalid.
* Legal Status: The Supreme Court of Virginia ruled that its review of the underlying case "has no effect on the referendum scheduled for April 21st", essentially allowing the vote to proceed.
* Proposed Map: The amendment would allow for immediate re-drawing of the state's 11 congressional districts, with a proposed map drawn by Democrats to heavily favor Democrats (potentially 10D-1R).

IF YOU ARE CONFUSED, THIS IS BY DESIGN BY DEMOCRATS! This would disenfranchise millions of Virginia voters! Please contact your local GOP committee for information about signs and local meetings discussing this referendum. Also, please help us inform voters by sharing this one-pager crated byThe Family Foundation:

body:
Minnesota deserves answers

| | **Request for Update and Continued Action on Federal Fraud Investigation in Minnesota**

---
| | President Trump and the leadership of the United States Attorney Generals office,
I am writing as a concerned Minnesotan **seeking clarity and renewed urgency regarding the major fraud** investigations previously underway in our state.
It has now been roughly two months since the resignation of acting MN U.S. **Attorney Joe Thompson. During his tenure, he brought to light what was reported to be the first $9 billion in uncovered fraud and communicated those findings directly to the public.** That level of transparency and action gave Minnesotans confidence that meaningful progress was being made.
Since his departure, however, we have not heard a clear update regarding forward motion in the investigation of fraud in Minnesota. What specific steps has now U.S. Attorney Daniel Rosen taken to further this work? If progress is being made, we respectfully ask that it be communicated to the public. If I am missing important developments, please inform me.
From the beginning, I stated that losing Joe Thompson would be a significant setback. In my view, he was focused, effective, and committed to uncovering taxpayer fraud and abuse. Minnesotans do not want this issue to lose momentum or shift in priority. Fraud on this scale demands sustained attention and decisive action.
**Our state leadership, including Attorney General Keith Ellison, has not demonstrated the urgency many of us believe this situation warrants.** Whether through inaction or indifference, state-level efforts have not provided the accountability taxpayers deserve. That is why we look to **federal leadership** to ensure this investigation continues without delay.
Minnesotans are not a “brush it under the rug” kind of people. We expect transparency. We expect accountability. And we are not going to let this go.
**Please do not allow the momentum to stall.** Continue pressing forward, keep the public informed, and **demonstrate that** **large-scale taxpayer fraud will be pursued fully and without hesitation.**
We are watching, we care deeply about this issue, and we expect answers.
Respectfully,
**Alycia R. Gruenhagen** **Candidate for U.S. Senate, Minnesota** Glencoe, MN **www.alycia4senate.com** Proudly representing OUR SHARED Minnesota values.

Kirsten Gillibrand, DSCC Chair RE: Democrats’ Roadmap to a Senate Majority in 2026 We’re approaching the midterms, friends, and Senate Democrats are ready to compete everywhere, especially in the battleground states. Democrats have recruited the most formidable candidates possible, while Republicans are bogged down by infighting and a toxic agenda that voters are rejecting. We also have proven messaging to back up these candidates: We are the party that will cut costs, stand up for America, and fight for working-class families. Here’s a breakdown of our top flip opportunities: Top Flip Opportunities North Carolina – We recruited Gov. Roy Cooper – a proven Democratic leader who’s never lost an election. Ohio – Sherrod Brown stepped up to run. He is beloved statewide with name recognition, and running against an appointed opponent. Maine – Susan Collins is in her weakest position ever as she faces down a tough Democrat challenge. Alaska – Mary Peltola – a proven statewide winner in a purple state who puts cost-of-living and health care first, is ready to flip this seat. Iowa – Democrats are overperforming in recent special elections here, and Republicans are getting nervous. Texas – Democrats are gaining ground and momentum, while Republicans are burning tens of millions of dollars in a chaotic primary. The path is clear, friends. And these six states are our best opportunity to take back the Senate from Trump’s MAGA extremists. Will you help us reach our $20,000 weekly goal by chipping in $6 before 11:59 PM? We must ensure these six Senate races have enough resources to compete with the GOP’s billionaire backers! >> [RUSH A DONATION >>] – Kirsten Gillibrand A message from DSCC Chair Kirsten Gillibrand: []

Derek, I told you yesterday that I would force a vote on my Iran War Powers Resolution — and now we have a critical update:
The Senate will vote tomorrow, Wednesday, March 4, on my legislation to block Donald Trump from unauthorized and illegal military hostilities in Iran.
Every senator will have to go on the record tomorrow and declare whether it is in our best interest to send our sons and daughters into conflict against Iran.
I urge every one of my colleagues in the strongest possible terms to vote to end this dangerous, unnecessary, and illegal war that has already resulted in the loss of six servicemembers and more than a hundred civilians.
I’m asking for your help to raise a strong public outcry on this issue.
Before the Senate votes tomorrow, will you show your support for my War Powers Resolution by signing your name? [https://secure.ngpvan.com/gmu5Uan1t0eY4CoEPPbcug2]
ADD YOUR NAME [https://secure.ngpvan.com/gmu5Uan1t0eY4CoEPPbcug2]
Thank you for speaking out. Please forward this email to your friends and family and ask them to join you.
—Tim Kaine
---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Tim Kaine <info@timkaine.com>
Date: Mon, Mar 2, 2026
Subject: Trump’s illegal war in Iran
Friends,
The news that the United States has joined Israel in starting an offensive war against Iran while in the middle of diplomatic negotiations is tragic and deeply alarming.
As a member of the Senate Armed Services and Foreign Relations Committees, with access to classified information about threats from Iran and others, I can say plainly that there was no imminent threat to the United States.
Not a single one that justified sending our sons and daughters into another Middle East war — especially without the public debate and vote that the Constitution requires from Congress before any declaration of war.
That’s why I’m insisting the Senate immediately return to session and vote on my War Powers Resolution to stop illegal U.S. hostilities against Iran.
Congress cannot remain silent while a president wages war without authorization, and every single Senator needs to go on the record about this dangerous, unnecessary, and frankly idiotic action.
More war is not the answer. If it were, the last 70 years would have produced a better outcome than what we see today.
President Trump tore up a working diplomatic agreement that prevented Iran from obtaining nuclear weapons.

| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | **A PROVEN CONSERVATIVE FOR ATTORNEY GENERAL**
---
| | Friends,
I’m Stephen Goldfinch, and I’m running to be South Carolina’s next Attorney General.
I’m running because our state needs a chief law enforcement officer who will enforce the law, defend our Constitution, and stand firm against government overreach in every form. Protecting public safety and protecting individual liberty go hand in hand and I will never compromise either.
Throughout my career, I’ve led the fight to strengthen sentencing and bond laws to hold repeat offenders accountable and keep dangerous criminals off our streets. Public safety isn’t a talking point for me. It’s a responsibility.
I helped create South Carolina’s Illegal Immigration Task Force to ensure our laws are enforced and our communities are protected. The rule of law matters and as Attorney General, I will enforce it consistently and without apology.
I’ve been a lifelong Republican, and I’m proud to stand behind President Trump’s America-First agenda: strong borders, law and order, and unwavering respect for the Constitution. And I will push back against federal overreach or bureaucrats who threaten the rights of South Carolinians.
I also bring real courtroom experience. As a military JAG prosecutor, I have prosecuted thousands of cases and stood up for victims, service members, and justice.
If you want a proven conservative who delivers results, defends freedom, and keeps our communities safe, I’m asking for your support.

Onward,
Stephen Goldfinch

---
| |
# ENDORSEMENT CORNER
---
| |
I’m honored to receive the endorsement of Florence County Sheriff TJ Joye. The support of our law enforcement community means a great deal to me, and I’m grateful for Sheriff Joye’s trust and leadership. As Attorney General, I will always back the blue, enforce the law, and fight every day to keep South Carolina families safe.

The news isn't telling the full story.

# Clinton grins as he's handed incriminating Epstein hot tub snap
Former President Bill Clinton smiled and chuckled during a heated House Oversight Committee deposition this week as **[he examined a resurfaced 2002 photo from Jeffrey Epstein's files](https://substack.com/redirect/b469c695-10b5-4862-adbe-cb00d7162f58?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** showing him reclining in a Brunei hotel hot tub beside a redacted figure, while denying any knowledge of Epstein's crimes or the image being taken.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b469c695-10b5-4862-adbe-cb00d7162f58?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Deposition Goes Viral:** Clinton spent over 20 seconds scrutinizing the printed hot tub photo before breaking into a smile and chuckle, with his lawyer attempting to hide a smirk amid intense questioning.
* **Photo Origin Revealed:** The intimate image, first released by the DOJ in December 2025 from Epstein's estate, captures Clinton during a 2002 Asia trip for AIDS initiatives where Epstein and Ghislaine Maxwell were present.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b469c695-10b5-4862-adbe-cb00d7162f58?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Clinton 's Firm Denials:** He insisted he did not know the redacted person next to him, had no interest in underage women, and severed ties with Epstein long before the financier's crimes surfaced publicly.
* **Ongoing Scrutiny Persists:** The session highlighted Clinton's multiple appearances in Epstein-related photos, including White House visits in 1993, fueling continued questions despite no evidence of wrongdoing beyond association.

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b469c695-10b5-4862-adbe-cb00d7162f58?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
