# State Dept officer slays four in DC road rage rampage
A **[U.S. State Department Foreign Service officer allegedly stabbed four women](https://substack.com/redirect/36018560-3fda-4151-ac77-5ced7863dac6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and a dog during a road rage incident on Virginia's Interstate 495 Sunday, killing one victim and a pet before a trooper fatally shot him in self-defense.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/f7084eff-3736-4a24-b66f-a58d90b611a6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **Deadly Stabbing Victims Identified:** Michelle Adams, 39, died from her wounds; three other women remain hospitalized with serious injuries after the attack near Little River Turnpike.
* **Suspect 's Government Role Revealed:** Jared Llamado, 32, of McLean, Virginia, worked as a diplomatic technology officer at the State Department since September 2024, handling IT systems for diplomatic functions.
* **Incident Escalation Details:** **[The rampage followed a crash](https://substack.com/redirect/cec09b49-42a2-45ed-a131-a3000c442969?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** on the Capital Beltway; Llamado confronted the responding Virginia State Police trooper armed with a knife.
* **Official Responses Issued:** State Department expressed condolences to all affected, deferred to police investigation; authorities ruled out terrorism, with the trooper uninjured and shooting deemed self-defense.

* * *
# Trump ends boycott, will attend Correspondents Dinner for the first time ever
President Donald Trump announced Monday he will attend the White House Correspondents' Association dinner **[for the first time as president on April 25,](https://substack.com/redirect/0fc13df2-aadf-4787-ace4-252746cef8b4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/0fc13df2-aadf-4787-ace4-252746cef8b4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)accepting an invitation he described as "very nice" after boycotting the event throughout his first term and skipping it in 2025, citing past media bias but now framing it as honoring America's 250th birthday and his status as one of the greatest presidents.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b037faee-ecdf-40a3-9c8c-58f011c2e0a6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **First Presidential Appearance:** Trump has never attended the annual dinner as president before, declining invitations during his 2017-2021 term and in 2025 due to perceived unfair media coverage.
* **Trump 's Enthusiastic Response:** He pledged to make the event the "GREATEST, HOTTEST, and MOST SPECTACULAR DINNER" ever, tying it to the nation's 250th anniversary celebrations.
* **Historical Tradition Highlighted:** The dinner, dating back to 1924 under President Calvin Coolidge, honors journalism and the First Amendment with awards and scholarships.
* **WHCA Welcomes Decision:** Association President Weijia Jiang expressed happiness at Trump's acceptance and anticipation for hosting him at the Washington event.

| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126579678/605339470/1498801184?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_Cruz_260303_T1_2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMzExMjdhYy01NDE3LWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2ExZjBhOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=lkF-1S5B9ASTrtpdfEiLtpSDKgNzS6cT9VcjX2Ezdq8=) Derek, I’m pissed off.

Ted Cruz just went on a baseless rampage saying that Democrats “side with the enemy of America.”

And since my Republican colleagues can’t seem to understand what putting America _first_ actually means, I’ll spell it out for them:

**I saw no intelligence that indicated there was an imminent threat from Iran against American forces. So, this a war of choice by Donald Trump.**

It’s a *choice* to send our sons and daughters into harm's way.

It’s a *choice* to spend billions of taxpayers’ dollars overseas.

**So when my Republican colleagues say we can’t afford to extend Obamacare tax credits that lower health care costs for millions of Americans – that’s a choice, too.**

If the President wants to make the case for a war of choice and believes it's more important to pay for that war than to help people pay for their health care, then Trump needs to say that.

That’s why it’s so deeply wrong for him to unilaterally start a war with no plan for what comes next, no clear objectives and a shifting rationale that prevents Americans from assessing the costs and benefits of what he is proposing.

If Donald Trump wants to start a war of choice he needs to come before Congress and get a declaration of war.

**And if my Republican colleagues can’t see that, then we need to beat them by huge margins at the ballot box this year.**

That’s why it’s so important voters like you stay engaged at this critical time. There’s so much on the line in November, and we’ve got to win in big numbers – here in Virginia and all across the country.

Thank you for being in this fight alongside me.

\- Mark Warner ********[Contribute](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126579680/605339472/1498801184?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_Cruz_260303_T1_2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMzExMjdhYy01NDE3LWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2ExZjBhOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=lkF-1S5B9ASTrtpdfEiLtpSDKgNzS6cT9VcjX2Ezdq8=)********

name: Ro Khanna
subject: Billionaires just recruited a candidate to primary me. Will you have my back?
body:
I stood up to billionaires. Now they recruited a candidate to run against me.
#
BREAKING: A billionaire-funded super PAC just recruited Ethan Agarwal to drop out of the Governor’s race and challenge me in the primary.
They’re coming after me for one simple reason – I am standing up to them.
[**Before I explain, will you rush a donation of $10 or more to my campaign to help me fight Big Money’s scare tactics?**](https://act.leftnet.org/go/22317?t=1&akid=1518%2E2118727%2ELGLKq9)
[****](https://act.leftnet.org/go/22318?t=2&akid=1518%2E2118727%2ELGLKq9)
**FIRST:** Thomas Massie and I led the fight to release the Epstein Files, taking on powerful elites who thought they were untouchable.
**NOW:** I’m standing up for working people and saying billionaires should pay a modest tax to help fund healthcare, igniting primary threats from ultra-wealthy elites in California.
**That’s all it took.** The ultra-wealthy don’t like being challenged. So they’re trying to buy a primary.
[](https://act.leftnet.org/go/22318?t=3&akid=1518%2E2118727%2ELGLKq9)
I don’t take PAC money. I don’t take lobbyist money. I don’t take corporate checks—not now, not ever. And that terrifies the elite because it means I can’t be bought.
They think they can drown us in outside spending. They’re about to find out they can’t drown out a movement.
**[If you believe Congress shouldn’t be auctioned off to the highest bidder, chip in $10 or whatever you can right now.](https://act.leftnet.org/go/22317?t=4&akid=1518%2E2118727%2ELGLKq9)**
**[DONATE ››](https://act.leftnet.org/go/22318?t=5&akid=1518%2E2118727%2ELGLKq9)**
Thank you for your support, your activism, and all that you do.
Onward,
Ro

I'm honored to announce that my friend, former Congresswoman Brenda Lawrence, and more than a dozen members of the Congressional Black Caucus have just endorsed my campaign for Senate.
I have to say, these endorsements are particularly close to my heart. It's special to know that so many of my colleagues trust in me and believe in me enough to lend their support to my campaign.
**Because as representatives in the Congressional Black Caucus, they are champions of their communities, and they inspire me each and every day. That includes my dear friend Lauren Underwood, whose endorsement I 'm so grateful to have:**
[](https://substack.com/redirect/8710a14c-6c71-49ac-876b-fbc436a55f10?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
These are leaders I've fought alongside since I was elected to the House in 2018. Every single one of these folks knows what it takes to fight - and win - for the working people we represent. They know what's at stake and what this election means. For their communities, for our country's future, for all of us.
[And with MAGA megadonors flooding this race with their millions, this is exactly what it's going to take to win here - a massive, grassroots movement of people who are ready to fight for a better future.](https://substack.com/redirect/cde339e1-0296-4f4a-b0c0-0a6c8844efc9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The reality is that ALL of our rights are at risk under Donald Trump's administration. The future of our country and, for so many, our freedoms and livelihoods are on the line.
Trump and his MAGA allies are out of control - and this battleground seat will mean the difference between holding Trump accountable or adding another rubber stamp to his dangerously chaotic agenda.
That's why none of us can afford to sit on the sidelines and give Trump another seat in the Senate.
That's why these congressional leaders have chosen to support my campaign. And I'm beyond grateful to know that they have my back in this fight. I've got theirs.
With grit,
Haley
* * *

A personal note from Haley 👋

I'm a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. I've spent my career fighting for Michigan's working families - and now I'm running for the U.S. Senate to keep standing up for the people I love.

But here's the truth: Senate control could come down to Michigan. And Trump and his megadonors know it. That's why they're gearing up to spend tens of millions to defeat me and hand this seat to a MAGA Republican.

I need your help to fight back. This race will be one of the most competitive - and expensive - in the country, and I'm counting on grassroots support to win.

If you're with me, will you chip in today?

Peter, **I wanted to reach out personally after President Trump has launched another dangerous, illegal attack on Iran without authorization from Congress.** We have no reason to believe America was at any imminent risk — especially after President Trump claimed to have “obliterated” Iran’s nuclear program in June. Instead of pursuing diplomacy, he chose unilateral military action that puts our troops in harm’s way and risks plunging the entire region into deeper conflict. Today, I want to hear directly from you:
## **Do you believe Congress should block further military strikes?**
| **[YES — CONGRESS MUST ACT NOW](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126580758/605342527/640326855?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NjhlNzA2ZC01OTE3LWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2ExZjBhOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xKW_huWfz-ynlxWxVUHnfvFlVUot9d7UoGmxVtdhGv4=)**
---
**[NO — LET THE STRIKES CONTINUE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126580759/605342528/640326855?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NjhlNzA2ZC01OTE3LWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2ExZjBhOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xKW_huWfz-ynlxWxVUHnfvFlVUot9d7UoGmxVtdhGv4=)**
---
Let me be clear: Iran’s Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei led a brutal and oppressive regime. I stand with the Iranian people bravely protesting for change. But this attack was not a plan for peace. It violates our Constitution and undermines Congress’s authority to decide when and how we send our service members into harm’s way.
**We have no kings in America.**
We are a democracy. The American people have been clear: they do not want another costly, endless war. They want us focused here at home — lowering the cost of groceries, expanding access to health care, and making sure everyone has a safe, affordable home.
**We must immediately pass a War Powers Resolution to rein in this unauthorized use of our military and taxpayer dollars.**
This is about defending our Constitution, protecting our troops, and ensuring that decisions about war and peace reflect the will of the American people — not the impulses of one man.
Thank you for standing up and making your voice heard today.
— Becca

name: Matias, United We Dream
subject: 🗣️ Students belong in the classroom, not in detention.
body:
We are a generation that cares for each other! Let’s prove it. | | | Hey Peter, Just last week, federal agents, pretending to be local police looking for a missing child, entered the residence hall of Elmina Aghayeva, a senior at Columbia University, and detained her. After students in NYC and around the country organized and mobilized, Elmina was released that same day. Unfortunately, Elmina’s story isn’t unique - we’re seeing more and more students and youth being targeted for detention and deportation. But young people aren’t just standing by. From San Diego to Dallas to NYC, young people are standing united in making it clear that ICE has no place in our classrooms and communities. These acts of courage are what builds change. **Our unity is what will keep us safe.** We have a right to safe spaces where we can learn and thrive. But, it’s impossible to focus on preparing for our future when ICE is taking our classmates, teachers, and loved ones away from us. [**Will you join us at our “Students Belong in the Classroom: ICE Out of Our Communities” Call on Thursday, March 26, at****6:30 pm ET/ 5:30 pm CT****to learn how we can stand up for ourselves and each other through peaceful protest, like walkouts?**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMchKqTlnDL9HV9V-hz_r8qN5sFN7uyIDHDQ_kqfTbgHp4-NNMt_dCSC98WtWjKpOyHQYfKseFNDhqRpms51whAcL6_qaZJ0TQFCd5WWrmLJBROfCBWE5FSOxHHd92b33hmDYZ65XlnvUVHech3utz0r-YWoCXqvPpBWL2HQT1H89sJr6uABgffj68rRjexXWKN143DloEnrkfDJNy1rMnPxSICMfj2lsvnEbW74lczzLKyofMvd5AN1iByJsnigTW_6E1dw6VtwAjEnLDK__ebkL0xiZtqgsjy-izHiMpfNY/4om/WkwoSdATTi21wXK3JP1jWA/h0/h001.qH8vmWuvvrbxzBQqzNUOshaO4b-xbi6rQPPn1FP_g_Y)Join us for a safe space where you can come together with students across the country to connect, vent, and make sense of this moment together: **[RSVP TODAY](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMchKqTlnDL9HV9V-hz_r8qN5sFN7uyIDHDQ_kqfTbgHp4-NNMt_dCSC98WtWjKpOyHQYfKseFNDhqRpms51whAcjo_maGbrndlPDY1oUg82jeuzCUaIl4QN-k8BCfzaju8Rh4BDkbNHsh6sYUIxxVXTNU4bj_gomOgLphFRX6HSy9_5ZHVlnotHYkXN4jqq_NNWzSdYd1cE1yN14FWzvEdiTiDJOSWj6FMjO-KCbm60xp4obSpy7KqrXei7xWaBIoWkDKHPCXFs68am9EBFraWf5NQKKSXdcajeZ1Iv5xAI1/4om/WkwoSdATTi21wXK3JP1jWA/h1/h001.5ofDfbFdkk3mGDHHMfwfYRZSWB2BI1mTriH4Y79shHw)** [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMchKqTlnDL9HV9V-hz_r8qN5sFN7uyIDHDQ_kqfTbgHp4-NNMt_dCSC98WtWjKpOyHQYfKseFNDhqRpms51whAdYgYVci5KCad5b-NRWajyuvXn9bxal0CRqrumdkYB51craYu0P9xVedOMWTKS3KTyyLMXNdSCOZbf4T4ivFJWE5ltTF8EvEXfL_-5MgMljrwyqzueg729r4O9zEj-YE_oBxFaWXI2GG3Pj7fugOqZhUNfJ1fSjx4VzfppvYXP0g_9O3Y166Tx6qr1IqnSfYoKFjHoO1vpckMLrUhWq1fMw/4om/WkwoSdATTi21wXK3JP1jWA/h2/h001.2docoejys-oDxCL1BGAJmnl1x2KWIr2oh0g3VJRw4b0)

Be part of building a future where everyone is free to live, speak, and be their unapologetic selves. Ready to have your friends and neighbors’ backs? Join our call to:
* 🫂 Make meaning of the moment we face!
* ✊ Explore the historical power of student-led movement, and learn why our organized action WORKS!
* 🏫 Learn how you can choose to exercise your First Amendment rights, including organizing a walkout

clean_body: We are a generation that cares for each other! Let’s prove it. | | | Hey Peter, Just last week, federal agents, pretending to be local police looking for a missing child, entered the residence hall of Elmina Aghayeva, a senior at Columbia University, and detained her. After students in NYC and around the country organized and mobilized, Elmina was released that same day. Unfortunately, Elmina’s story isn’t unique - we’re seeing more and more students and youth being targeted for detention and deportation. But young people aren’t just standing by. From San Diego to Dallas to NYC, young people are standing united in making it clear that ICE has no place in our classrooms and communities. These acts of courage are what builds change. Our unity is what will keep us safe. We have a right to safe spaces where we can learn and thrive. But, it’s impossible to focus on preparing for our future when ICE is taking our classmates, teachers, and loved ones away from us. us for a safe space where you can come together with students across the country to connect, vent, and make sense of this moment together: We’ve been handed a world much different than what we imagined growing up, but we have the power to reclaim our future and protect one another. Be part of building a future where everyone is free to live, speak, and be their unapologetic selves. Ready to have your friends and neighbors’ backs? Join our call to: 🫂 Make meaning of the moment we face! ✊ Explore the historical power of student-led movement, and learn why our organized action WORKS! 🏫 Learn how you can choose to exercise your First Amendment rights, including organizing a walkout 📝 Gain access to our suggestions toolkit for additional resources! We are a generation who cares for one another, and this is our moment to prove it. See you there, Matias and the UWD team | Follow us on: | | | | |

(And, no, you did not miss anything: Nothing has changed since Trump purported to issue a pardon this fall for Ms. Peters. The federal government _still_ has no power to pardon state-level offenses, like the ones that landed her in prison.) clean_body: I will always fight for what’s right. No one gets to undermine our democracy on my watch. That includes any attempt by the Trump administration to compromise our free and fair elections. You may have heard about Trump posting the other day — once again — about releasing Tina Peters, the former Mesa County clerk, who was found guilty of crimes related to the undermining of voting equipment as part of a conspiracy theory-fueled effort to cast doubts on the 2020 presidential election. (And, no, you did not miss anything: Nothing has changed since Trump purported to issue a pardon this fall for Ms. Peters. The federal government still has no power to pardon state-level offenses, like the ones that landed her in prison.) At the same time that the Trump Administration is defending those who undermine the integrity of our elections, it is apparently looking for opportunities to seriously harm our ability to vote in the 2026 elections. My bottom line is clear and simple: Trump is not above the law.
